sections.section: A-general-scope (TZ-2 lines 1-84: sections 1-4: general info, terms, goals/tasks, KPIs, normative basis, scope, roles). Adversarial re-verification: every probe ran on a copy of a freshly seeded scratch DB on an ephemeral port. The repo was not modified. Per-file node --test runs pass 38/38. Note that public/js/app.js was edited at 10:58 today, while the earlier audit was running, so line numbers in the original public-panel row are stale.

requirements.requirement: The platform serves IMV (customer, DNA/registry), the partner agencies (Ecology, Tax, Customs, Energy, Statistics agency) and the main users (exporters of fertilizer/steel/aluminium/cement/hydrogen, accredited verifiers, government bodies).
requirements.evidence: src/auth/rbac.js:7-20 defines roles for exporter, verifier, importer, IMV, methodology, tax, ecology, customs, energy, gov_analyst and sysadmin. There is no Statistics role (grep for statist/gdp/stat. in src finds only the NDC note at admin.js:174). The accredited-verifier registry exists: registry.js:292-293 (GET/POST /api/verifiers, perm verifiers.manage held by IMV), and the expiry check runs at assignment (verification.js:60). public/js/views/integrations.js:17 shows I11 Statistika as 'rejalashtirilgan'.
requirements.gap: The Statistics agency has no role, no data path and no integration, so GDP never reaches the NDC indicator.
requirements.fix: rbac.js: add ROLES.statistics {scope:'aggregate'} with PERMS ['dashboard.gov','refdata.read','refdata.propose'] and PROPOSE_PREFIX.statistics=['stat.']. refdata.js validateValue: add stat.gdp.<year> (non-negative number, constant 2010 prices, unit 'mlrd so'm') and stat.national_ghg.<year> to the numeric-family regex. Use them in the /api/dashboard/gov ndc block (see the analytics-panel row). Tests in tests/api.test.js: a statistics user's POST /api/refdata/proposals for stat.gdp.2025 returns 200, the same call for grid.ef returns 403, and GET /api/installations returns 403.

requirements.requirement: SEE is in tCO2e per tonne of good. Direct emissions = combustion + process + heat/cooling production. Indirect emissions = electricity, counted only for cement and fertilizers.
requirements.evidence: Correct in the main path: emissions.js:12-18 (indirect only for cement/fertilizer), 103-123 (specificEmissions, seeCbam). process-calc.js:206-219 handle heat_import/heat_export, and the F-5.6e test passes. Gap in the precursor path: process-calc.js:296-302 (resolvePrecursorSee, default branch) returns { seeDir: DV_tot*(1+mu), seeInd: 0 }, so the whole default value of a precursor, which per TZ is the 'jami' (total) value, is booked as direct. For direct-only groups (aluminium products using a 7601 default precursor, steel products using crude-steel or ferro-alloy defaults), seeCbam (emissions.js:120) then includes the precursor's indirect share. The TIF importer stores only one dv value (admin.js:47-48), so the split cannot be represented. Cooling has no separate stream type and is entered as heat (TJ), which is acceptable.
requirements.gap: For direct-only complex goods with default-valued precursors, the CBAM SEE can include indirect emissions that CBAM excludes. The importer drops the direct/indirect split.
requirements.fix: admin.js tifRowsToEntries: read 'direct' and 'indirect' default columns into value.dvDir and value.dvInd, alongside dvTot. refdata.js validateValue: allow optional numeric dvDir and dvInd. process-calc.js resolvePrecursorSee default branch: if dvDir is present, return seeDir = dvDir*(1+mu) and seeInd = (dvInd ?? dvTot-dvDir)*(1+mu); otherwise keep the current fallback and push a warning 'default precursor: direct/indirect split unknown'. Test in tests/core.test.js: an aluminium product with a default precursor whose dvDir=1.5 and dvTot=1.8 gives seeCbam that counts only 1.5*(1+mu)*M_p/AL from the precursor.

requirements.requirement: Precursors (clinker -> cement, ammonia -> ammonium nitrate) are included in the SEE of complex goods.
requirements.evidence: process-calc.js:236-242 and 279-303 support internal (recursive, cycle check at 283), supplier and default precursors. services/calc.js:49-55 limits internal precursors to the same operator. registry.js:58-63 validates precursor streams. The core test 'rekursiv prekursor zanjiri va sikl aniqlash' passes, and the demo AN process uses the internal ammonia precursor. Caveats are tracked in other rows: the shipped fertilizer template's default precursor 2814100000 has no value (UZ default values row), and default precursors lose the indirect split (SEE row).

requirements.ref: Terms - default value with mark-up from 2026
requirements.requirement: The default value is the EC value for Uzbekistan (EU 2025/2621), with a mark-up applied from 2026.
requirements.evidence: defaults.js:12-23: markupFor returns 0 before 2026, SEE_def = DV*(1+mu). Acceptance tests A.3 (1.692) and '5.7 misoli' (1.551/1.833, fertilizer 1%) pass. The hard-coded 2028 cap is covered in the 'parameters updatable without code change' row, and data coverage in the scope rows.

requirements.ref: Terms - national carbon price (direct, Art.9 deductible)
requirements.requirement: The national carbon price is the carbon tax actually paid per tCO2e in Uzbekistan. It is deductible from the EU importer's obligation under CBAM Art. 9.
requirements.evidence: tax.js:84 (effective, P_eff), tax.js:63 (paidUp), package.js:69 and admin.js:167 all select payments WHERE status IN ('paid','confirmed'). finance.js:150-157: an exporter's POST /api/tax/payments is inserted as 'paid' immediately, with no Tax Committee step. cbam.js:46 deducts ruzEur = net_t*cpUsd. Probe (scratch DB copy): sement_admin posted an unconfirmed 1e12 UZS payment (status 'paid'). P_eff for inst_cement 2026 went from 5.00 to 730.06 USD/t. CBAM 2026 for op_cement went to ruzEur = 5.25M EUR and euEur = 0, so the EU payment was wiped out. The sealed package listed the payment under the 'Carbon price paid certificate (CBAM Art. 9)' heading (package.js:17/26).
requirements.gap: An exporter's own unconfirmed payment entries raise P_eff, cancel the computed EU payment, and appear in the sealed package as a deductible carbon price.
requirements.fix: tax.js effective() and declaration() paidUp, package.js:69 and admin.js:167: count only status='confirmed' as deductible. Return paidUnconfirmedUsd separately, and render it in toHtml/toDocx/communication XLSX under 'Paid, awaiting Tax Committee confirmation (not deductible)'. Optional refdata flag tax.deduct_unconfirmed (bool, default false; extend validateValue). Tests: an unconfirmed payment leaves pEff at 0 and ruzEur at 0. After POST /api/tax/payments/:id/confirm by the tax role, both change.

requirements.ref: 2 Goal - per-batch EE + carbon price + exporter package
requirements.requirement: For every export batch, compute embedded emissions by the EU method, document the carbon price paid in Uzbekistan, and auto-generate the 'Exporter document package' for the EU importer's deduction.
requirements.evidence: The pipeline exists: finance.js:40-67 (batches), cbam.js:39-61 (EE_s = m_s*SEE), package.js:47-82 (build), reports.js:44-49 (5 formats, sealed). But: (1) Verified actual data never reaches the package or the CBAM path. verification.js:116-124 only sets calc_results.status='verified'. The stored result JSON keeps the selection computed at save time, when verified was false (process-calc.js:262 via services/calc.js:48,68). officialSee (services/calc.js:99-103) and package.build (package.js:53-55) read that stored selection. Probe on the seeded verified cement 2025 result: officialSee basis 'default', applied 1.41. Live calc: basis 'actual', applied 0.618. cbam.operatorYear 2025 batches: see 1.41 with resultStatus 'verified'. Package goods: basis 'default' and applied 1.41, next to verification.opinion 'positive'. (2) Unlinked batches are silently dropped from the package: package.js:73 keeps only batches whose processId matches a good, and cbam.js:41 returns processId null. (3) Batches with basis 'none' get EE null (cbam.js:43). (4) The carbon-price section includes unconfirmed payments (see the national carbon price row). Generation itself is fast (milliseconds).
requirements.gap: After a positive verification, the package and the CBAM figures still apply default SEE (2.3x higher in the demo). Batches that are not linked or have no SEE are omitted or null without any warning in the package.
requirements.fix: (a) verification.js conclude: inside the tx, for each verified result, recompute the selection with verified=true from the stored result (D.selectSee({actual: r.see.seeCbam, verified:true, tif:r.tif, mu:r.markup})), then UPDATE calc_results SET result=?, see_applied=?, basis=?. Alternatively, make officialSee() and package.build() re-derive the selection at read time from status==='verified'. (b) package.build: include every batch of the installation's operator for the year whose TIF matches the installation, plus unresolved ones, in a 'batchesUnresolved' list with a reason. Render pkg.goods[].warnings and the unresolved batches in toHtml/toDocx/toCommunicationXlsx. (c) Refuse POST/GET issue (409) when any good has basis 'none', unless ?draft=1. Tests in tests/api.test.js, after conclude: package json goods[0].basis==='actual' and applied===seeCbam, and GET /api/cbam/operator/op_a batches[0].see===seeCbam.

requirements.requirement: Reproduce the 2025 baseline: 565 414 t, 1 149 654 tCO2e, 100% CBAM = 100.0 mln USD (99.6% fertilizers, 0.4% metal, about 100 mln/year by 2034).
requirements.evidence: tests/acceptance.test.js:11-29 (A.1) reproduces 565 414.2 t, 1 149 654.3 t and 100.02 mln USD at 87 USD/t with CF=0 (the 2034 case). Fertilizer share = (52.14+43.73+3.70)/100.02 = 99.55%. The test passes. Limitation: it is a formula check on hard-coded rows, not data in the platform. The 140.4 mln USD export value cannot be reproduced because batches have no customs-value field; only process-level export_price_usd exists (registry.js:34).

requirements.requirement: A single MRV system at installation level covering activity data, fuel, electricity, precursors and product.
requirements.evidence: schema.js (operators/installations/processes/streams/activity). registry.js:157-257 (CRUD, templates). data.js:99-180 (monthly grid, CSV, CEMS, evidence). process-calc.js:25-30 stream types. The API test 'To'liq MRV oqimi' passes.

requirements.ref: 2 Task - SEE from actual or default
requirements.requirement: Compute SEE for CBAM goods from actual data or the default value (sec. 5).
requirements.evidence: The pure rule is correct: defaults.js:32-51 (verified actual -> default -> unverified actual), and the core test passes. But the persisted official result never switches to actual. saveResult (services/calc.js:66-77) stores selection with verified=false because verification requires a previously submitted result (verification.js:116-117). Conclude (verification.js:121-124) only flips the status, and officialSee/package.build use the stored selection. Probe: cement 2025 with verification 'positive' gives officialSee.basis='default' and applied=1.41, while live computeProcess gives basis='actual' and applied=0.618. The API test only asserts the live endpoint (tests/api.test.js:156-157), so it misses this. Re-saving after verification does not help: officialSee orders verified rows first (services/calc.js:100).
requirements.gap: In every official consumer (CBAM calculator, gov aggregates, exporter package, exporter dashboard CBAM block), verified actual SEE is never applied. Default (or unverified-actual) values persist after a positive opinion.
requirements.fix: Same as fix (a) of the Goal row: recompute and persist selection/see_applied/basis for results verified in conclude (verification.js:121-124), or derive the selection at read time in officialSee() from the result status. Add a regression test that checks officialSee(...).result.selection.basis === 'actual' after conclude.

requirements.ref: 2 Task - national carbon tax calc + payment confirmation
requirements.requirement: Compute the national carbon tax obligation (upstream fuel excise, downstream process emissions) and confirm the payment (sec. 6).
requirements.evidence: tax.js:48-78 computes the declaration in modes up/down1/down2. finance.js:162-169 is the confirm endpoint. The declaration is recomputed on every GET and never stored or filed (reports.js:59-76 labels its XML 'loyiha', i.e. draft). Confirmation gates nothing (see the national carbon price row). tax.mode is not validated (refdata.js:17 regex omits it). Probe: tax.mode='bogus' was accepted and the declaration returned mode 'bogus', budget 'UGL-02' and down2 coverage.
requirements.gap: There is no filed or stored declaration lifecycle, confirmation is cosmetic, and the mode parameter is not validated.
requirements.fix: See the Tax Committee rows: a tax_declarations table with filing and decision, plus confirmation-gated deduction. Also extend validateValue so that key 'tax.mode' must be one of 'up','down1','down2' (400 otherwise). Test: proposing tax.mode='x' returns 400.

requirements.ref: 2 Task - CBAM 2026-2034 forecast + national price deduction
requirements.requirement: Forecast CBAM payments for 2026-2034 by scenario and estimate the national price deduction.
requirements.evidence: cbam.js:82-103 (scenarioTable, sensitivity, ETS scenarios), finance.js:114-120, and the A.2 acceptance test passes. But cbam.js:90 uses see = r.see.seeCbam (actual, even if unverified) whenever it is finite, and falls back to the applied default only when there is no actual data. For a process with unverified actual SEE below the default (demo cement: 0.62 actual vs 1.55-1.83 default), the forecast understates the legally applicable CBAM payment by about 60%. P_ETS comes from the constant ets.reference_usd (cbam.js:97), while operatorYear uses ets.price_eur (cbam.js:23), so ETS updates through I9 do not move the forecast.
requirements.gap: The forecast silently uses unverified actual SEE instead of the applicable value, with no option to compare basis scenarios. It also uses a different ETS price source from the CBAM calculator.
requirements.fix: cbam.scenario: add param seeBasis 'applied'|'actual'|'default' (default 'applied' = officialSee().result.selection.applied) and return both actual and default results for comparison. Default etsUsd = ets.price_eur * fx.EUR/fx.USD unless overridden, and keep ets.reference_usd only for the A.2 reproduction. Expose these in finance.js:115 and public/js/views/cbam.js. Test: with unverified actual 0.62 and default 1.551, seeBasis='applied' uses 1.551.

requirements.ref: 2 Task - AI data quality & anomaly detection
requirements.requirement: Use AI to control data quality and detect anomalies.
requirements.evidence: data.js:73-93 qualityIndex. src/ai/anomaly.js (rules + median/MAD SPC + iforest.js). ai.js:34-59 anomalies plus the human decision logged in ai_log. The tests 'AI-3 Isolation Forest' pass. Detailed AI-3 quality metrics are section 8 scope.

requirements.requirement: Use AI to classify goods into TIF TN codes.
requirements.evidence: ai.js:19 MODELS lists AI-2 as status 'rejalashtirilgan' with version '-'. Grep for tif in src/ai finds only anomaly.js default-value checks and reconcile. Process TIF is a free-text input (public/js/views/registry.js:95), as are precursor TIF (registry.js:86) and batch TIF (views/batches.js:25).
requirements.gap: There is no TIF suggestion or classification at all.
requirements.fix: Add src/ai/tifclass.js: BM25 over refdata tif.* names (reuse the tokenizer in src/ai/kb.js) plus chapter rules (2523/2808/2814/2834 21/3102/3105/7601-7616/280410/2601 12/7201-7229/7301-7326), returning the top 3 {code, score, group, dvStatus}. Endpoint POST /api/ai/tif-suggest {description, goodsGroup?} with perm ['registry.write','batches.write','ai.use'], logged to ai_log kind 'tif'. UI: a suggest button and datalist in the views/registry.js process form and the views/batches.js form. Test with a labelled fixture of the 14 seeded codes: top-1 >= 95% (TZ target).

requirements.requirement: Use AI to give decarbonization recommendations.
requirements.evidence: advice.js:13-65 (MACC measure library per group, labelled 'taxminiy, ekspert tasdig'i talab qilinadi'). ai.js:93-97 /api/ai/recommendations. UI in public/js/views/ai.js:30-33.

requirements.requirement: Integrate with the EU CBAM Registry O3CI.
requirements.evidence: package.js:93-121 toXml emits a custom <CBAMOperatorPackage>. Line 104 says the official XSD mapping is deferred to I1. package.js:176-191 toCommunicationXlsx is a 4-sheet custom layout, not the official EU Communication Template. views/integrations.js:7 says 'kirish berilgach'. There is no transmission code and nothing in integration_log for O3CI.
requirements.gap: The output is not in the official O3CI/Communication-template schema and is never transmitted.
requirements.fix: src/docs/o3ci.js: map the package to the official O3CI XSD (installation, production processes, goods CN8, SEE dir/ind, precursors, carbon price paid with confirmation reference). Validate against the XSD with a bundled minimal validator, or a structural check if no XSD library exists. Adapter src/services/integrations/o3ci.js with mock and live modes, writing to integration_log. Button 'Send to O3CI' with status tracking in views/docs.js.

requirements.requirement: Integrate with the Tax Committee e-invoice system (two-line e-faktura).
requirements.evidence: Only a STIR lookup mock exists (admin.js:186-195). There is no e-faktura import, matching or two-line (excise + carbon tax) handling anywhere in src (grep efaktura/e-faktura finds only the views/integrations.js:8 label).
requirements.gap: There is no e-invoice data path.
requirements.fix: src/services/integrations/efaktura.js: mock mode imports an e-invoice CSV (seller STIR, buyer STIR, fuel code, qty, excise line, carbon-tax line) into a new table efaktura_lines in schema.js. Match lines to installations' fuel streams and to tax_payments. Endpoint GET /api/tax/efaktura-reconcile?year= (perm tax.read). Live mode once credentials exist.

requirements.requirement: Integrate with Customs (export declarations).
requirements.evidence: The customs role enters batches manually or by CSV (finance.js:31-39, 90-106). views/integrations.js:9 says the API is 'kirish berilgach'. There is no automated feed.
requirements.gap: There is no automated customs feed. Reconciliation defects are in the Customs role row.
requirements.fix: Adapter src/services/integrations/customs.js (mock CSV/JSON drop folder, live API later) writing into a customs_declarations staging table (see the Customs row), logged to integration_log.

requirements.ref: 2 Task - integration National carbon units registry
requirements.requirement: Integrate with the National carbon units registry (run by IMV from 2026-01-01).
requirements.evidence: finance.js:192-206 registers an ITMO with a fabricated registry_id 'UZ-ITMO-<year>-<id>' and writes integration_log status 'mock'. It also sets verified=1 without any ER verification (finance.js:202).
requirements.gap: Mock only. ITMO projects are marked verified on registration.
requirements.fix: Adapter src/services/integrations/registry.js with an issuance/transfer contract, idempotency key = project id + vintage, and retries. Keep the mock for dev. Do not set verified=1 until an ER verification record exists.

requirements.requirement: Analytics panel for government bodies: revenue, emissions, NDC indicators.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:164-175 and views/dashboard.js:64-92 show emissions, export, CBAM risk, tax paid and a revenue forecast. The NDC block (admin.js:174, dashboard.js:91) shows only the static target and a 'data missing' note. CBAM risk uses the constant ets.reference_usd (admin.js:170) and EE computed from the stale official selection (default SEE after verification, see the SEE row). taxPaidUzs includes unconfirmed payments (admin.js:167).
requirements.gap: No NDC indicator is computed. Revenue and risk figures inherit the unconfirmed-payment and stale-SEE defects.
requirements.fix: Compute intensity = covered (or stat.national_ghg) emissions / stat.gdp.<year>. Compare with refdata ndc.base_intensity_2010 and ndc.target_reduction_2030, returning {intensity, base, reductionPct, target, onTrack}, and add a dashboard tile. Use confirmed payments only for taxPaidUzs. Test with stub refdata.

requirements.requirement: The platform can measure the share of CBAM-goods exporters registered (target 100% within 6 months of launch).
requirements.evidence: No universe of CBAM exporters is stored. Probe: customs POST /api/batches with an unknown STIR returns 400 'Eksportyor (operatorId yoki STIR) topilmadi' (finance.js:33-35), so unregistered exporters leave no trace. admin.js:171 counts only operators with computable processes. There is no KPI tile.
requirements.gap: The denominator (all exporters of CBAM goods to the EU) is never captured, so the KPI cannot be measured.
requirements.fix: Add a customs_declarations staging table (declaration_no, date, tif_code, net_t, country, exporter_stir, operator_id NULL allowed). The customs import writes there even for unknown STIRs. KPI = distinct registered STIRs / distinct STIRs with EU-destination CBAM-TIF declarations since refdata kpi.launch_date. Add a gov dashboard tile with target and deadline. Test: one registered and one unregistered STIR gives 50%.

requirements.requirement: The platform measures the share of export volume covered by actual verified data.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:152 sums exported only from batches WHERE process_id = ?, so unlinked batches are dropped (cbam.js:40 links at read time, aggregate does not). Probe: adding an unlinked 100 000 t 2025 batch leaves the denominator at 180 282.8 t instead of 280 282.8 t. The numerator counts o.status==='verified' (admin.js:154,159,168) while the applied SEE in the same rows is still 'default' (SEE row), so the 2025 demo reports 40.2% 'verified' although 0% of exports actually use verified actual SEE. There is no target or trend display (dashboard.js:75).
requirements.gap: The KPI is inflated (unlinked batches excluded) and inconsistent: it counts 'verified' status, not the actual basis applied. There is no 80%/2028 tracking.
requirements.fix: aggregate(): denominator = all EU batches of the year (resolve process via cbam.linkProcess, count unresolved as unverified). Numerator = batches whose official selection basis==='actual', after fixing the SEE row. Add refdata kpi.verified_share_target (0.8) and kpi.verified_share_year (2028), and a multi-year trend. Tests: one unlinked batch lowers the share. A verified result counts only when basis==='actual'.

requirements.requirement: The difference between platform results and a manual check is <=1% in acceptance tests.
requirements.evidence: tests/acceptance.test.js reproduces TZ Appendix A within 0.1% (tests/helpers.js:13). Per-file runs pass 38/38. `node --test tests/` with a directory argument fails on this Windows/Node 24 setup (MODULE_NOT_FOUND), while `npm test` with the glob in package.json works. Process-level cases in tests/core.test.js cover only cement, the fertilizer precursor chain and a '-' code. REJA.md admits '[ ] har bir guruhga >=3 qo'lda Excel etaloni'.
requirements.gap: There are no independent manual (Excel) process-level references for aluminium, hydrogen or iron/steel, and none built from real installation data.
requirements.fix: Add tests/etalon/<group>-N.json (inputs plus expected values from the customer's manual Excel) and tests/etalon.test.js that runs calculateProcess with refStub and asserts within 1% (target 0.1%), at least 3 per group. Document `npm test` as the canonical runner.

requirements.requirement: The exporter package is produced within one working day, and this is measured.
requirements.evidence: Generation is on demand and synchronous (reports.js:25-49), taking milliseconds. The audit log records package.issue (reports.js:27) and verification.conclude (verification.js:124), but no lead time is computed or shown.
requirements.gap: The capability is met, but the KPI is neither measured nor reported.
requirements.fix: KPI query: per installation-year, working days between the first 'verification.conclude' (or the first 'calc.submit' when unverified) and the first 'package.issue' in the audit log. Use a business-day function with a refdata holiday list. Show the median and the share <=1 day on the gov dashboard. Test with synthetic audit rows.

requirements.requirement: The platform measures carbon-tax collection (Strategy KPI >=97% from 2026).
requirements.evidence: reports.js:136-148: collection = paid/estimatedDue. paid includes unconfirmed exporter rows of both kinds (lines 138-139). Due always uses variant 'up' (line 145) regardless of tax.mode, and for the current year is computed YTD by computeProcess while payments can cover any period. There is no plausibility check. Probe: one unconfirmed 1e12 UZS exporter entry gives collection = 27.39 (2 739%). The LEFT JOIN processes is dead code (goods_group is never used), so it is harmless.
requirements.gap: The numerator is not confirmed revenue, and the denominator matches neither the active tax mode, the payment kinds nor the periods, so the value is unreliable and easy to manipulate.
requirements.fix: Numerator = status='confirmed' payments of the kinds matching tax.mode. Denominator = filed or assessed liabilities from tax_declarations (Tax Committee row) for the same periods, falling back to declaration(s,inst,year,period,mode) per period. Report by period and kind, and flag collection >1.05. Remove the processes join. Tests: an unconfirmed payment does not raise collection. With tax.mode=down2 the down liability is included.

requirements.requirement: System availability >=99.5%, measured.
requirements.evidence: Only a health endpoint exists (admin.js:228, /api/system/health, auth:false). There is no uptime probe, availability log or report. REJA.md N3 is unchecked.
requirements.gap: Availability is not measured.
requirements.fix: Add an uptime_log table and a probe: an external cron, or an in-process setInterval(60s) that records status and latency of a DB ping. Compute monthly availability in a sysadmin view, GET /api/system/availability?month= (perm system.read), with a notification below 99.5%. HA and backups are infrastructure, outside the code.

requirements.requirement: Formula parameters live in reference data with validity dates and two-person approval. Calculations record the versions used.
requirements.evidence: Versioning, snapshots and pinning work: refdata.js:72-89, services/calc.js:60,71-73, compare at 84-96. Two-person approval for user proposals works (refdata.js:120; the API test passes). But the rule is bypassed for a core CBAM parameter: admin.js:219-225 /api/integrations/ets calls ref.systemSet, which self-approves (refdata.js:139-145). Probe: customs, tax and sysadmin each set ets.price_eur with immediate effect. Backdated entries corrupt history (closePrevious row).
requirements.gap: The two-person rule does not hold for ets.price_eur, and backdated versions wipe later ones.
requirements.fix: See the 'reference data managed only by IMV' row (route ETS through propose/approve) and the 'backdated correction' row (closePrevious rewrite).

requirements.requirement: Updating a parameter through reference data must not corrupt other validity periods.
requirements.evidence: refdata.js:147-152 closePrevious marks every active row with valid_from >= the new validFrom as 'superseded', and the new row gets valid_to NULL. Probe: ets.price_eur 80@2026-06-01 and 90@2026-09-01, then a correction 70@2026-03-01. snapshot('2026-10-01') returns 70 (was 90), and 80 and 90 become 'superseded'.
requirements.gap: A backdated correction silently wipes all later versions (e.g. daily fx from CBU or later ETS prices), so later calculations use the wrong value.
requirements.fix: Rewrite closePrevious(key, validFrom, newId): supersede only an active row with the identical valid_from. Set valid_to = validFrom on the nearest earlier active row. Set the new row's valid_to = MIN(valid_from) of later active rows. Add tests/refdata.test.js covering insert-before, insert-between, insert-after, the same date, and that snapshot() at each boundary returns the expected value.

requirements.ref: 3 All formula parameters updatable without code change

requirements.evidence: src/api/auth.js:3 comment 'OneID/ERI integratsiyasi I10 adapteri orqali ulanadi; hozircha lokal login + TOTP'. The only login is password POST /api/auth/login (auth.js:36-53). requirements.fix: Add src/auth/oneid.js: authorization code + PKCE, state/nonce in a short-lived signed cookie, token exchange, userinfo -> {pinfl, tin, name}. Add GET /api/auth/oneid/start and GET /api/auth/oneid/callback in src/api/auth.js. requirements.requirement: Users log in with an ERI digital-signature key
requirements.evidence: src/api/auth.js has no challenge or signature login. 'mock-ERI' exists only as HMAC signing of verification opinions (src/api/verification.js:17-19) and package seals (src/docs/package.js:85-90). public/js/views/integrations.js:16 lists it as planned.
requirements.gap: No signature-based login: no challenge, no PKCS#7/CMS verification, no certificate-to-user mapping.
requirements.fix: Add GET /api/auth/eri/challenge: a random nonce stored with a 120 s TTL in a new table eri_challenges. Add POST /api/auth/eri/login {pkcs7, challengeId}: verify the CMS signature over the nonce, validate the chain against trusted CA certificates in data/eri-ca/ (node:crypto X509Certificate, validity dates, CRL/OCSP stub), extract TIN/PINFL from the subject OIDs, map to the user, create the session as in the OneID row, and audit. Frontend: E-IMZO browser plugin API in public/js/app.js. Tests use a self-signed test CA generated in the test: valid signature gives 200; wrong nonce, expired certificate or untrusted CA give 401. Reuse the same adapter later to replace the HMAC mock-ERI in verification.js and package.js.

requirements.requirement: Register production processes (one CBAM goods category each, TIF code, route, system boundary)
requirements.evidence: processSchema (src/api/registry.js:30-35): goodsGroup enum; tifCode is only /^\d{10}$/; route and boundary are free text. Reproduced in verify_d1_http.js #2: a cement process with fertilizer TIF 3102300000 gets 200, and unknown TIF 9999999999 also gets 200. A TIF/group mismatch only becomes a calc-time warning (src/core/process-calc.js:264). No edit UI.

Return 400 if tif.group !== goodsGroup. Return 409 on goodsGroup/tifCode changes when calc_results with status submitted/verified exist for the process. Add refdata key cbam.routes.<group> and a route select in the form. Add a process edit form in views/registry.js. Tests: cement + 3102300000 gives 400; a goodsGroup change after verification gives 409.

requirements.requirement: Register source streams per process
requirements.evidence: streamSchema (src/api/registry.js:36-48) has 15 types (STREAM_TYPES, process-calc.js:25-30); checkStream at registry.js:51-65; POST/PUT/DELETE at registry.js:228-257. The UI form (public/js/views/registry.js:71-89) lacks of, cf, eta, tier and meterId; the only edit is the active toggle (views/registry.js:109). PUT /api/streams/:id does not re-check precursorProcessId access. verify_d1_http.js #5a vs #5b: POST with B's process gives 403, but PUT with B's process gives 200 and the foreign id is stored. The calc later refuses it (src/services/calc.js:52), so this is an integrity issue, not a data leak. There is no lock after verification: audit1.js #5 changed the fuel EF after verification and the live seeCbam went from 0.6088 to 0.9736 with basis still 'actual'. The unit is not checked against the fuel reference unit: a natural_gas stream in 'm3' makes the whole process throw at calc time (verify_d1.js #3).

requirements.fix: In views/registry.js add OF, CF, eta, tier, meter select and an edit dialog that uses PUT /api/streams/:id. In PUT call A.processRow(db, user, b.precursorProcessId) when supplied. In checkStream validate unit vs fuel.unit using toFuelUnit (add a 'm3' <-> '1000m3' factor); return 400 on mismatch. Block calculation-relevant changes (type, unit, ef, ncv, of, cf, carbon, efSource, precursor*) with 409 when the process has a submitted or verified calc_result for any year whose verification is concluded. Otherwise version the stream config (see the M4 selection row). Tests: PUT with a foreign precursorProcessId gives 403; PUT ef after verification gives 409; a natural gas stream with unit m3 is converted or gets 400.

requirements.requirement: Link the installation to its installation ID in O3CI
requirements.evidence: Stored in installations.o3ci_installation_id (schema.js:30), set at creation (registry.js:28; views/registry.js:32), exported in the package (package.js:77,107,180). Editable only through the API (PUT registry.js:167-175); no edit UI. No format or uniqueness validation. No O3CI adapter or lookup.

requirements.fix: Add an installation edit form (PUT /api/installations/:id). Add a unique partial index on o3ci_installation_id WHERE NOT NULL, and a regex once the O3CI format is confirmed. Add a src/integrations/o3ci.js stub verifyInstallation(id) with a mock and integration_log. Tests: a duplicate ID gives 400; editing the ID updates the next package.

requirements.requirement: For each source stream define the method: calculation, mass balance or measurement
requirements.evidence: The method enum exists (src/api/registry.js:39) with a UI select (views/registry.js:74). checkStream (registry.js:51-65) never validates it, and calculateProcess derives the method only from stream.type (process-calc.js:112-245). Reproduced in verify_d1_http.js #4: a fuel stream with method=measurement gets 200.

requirements.ref: M2 parameter source (and 5.9 source level per parameter)
requirements.requirement: Define the source of each parameter (measured / lab / supplier / default); 5.9 requires a source level for every parameter

requirements.evidence: streams.meter_id exists (schema.js:49; registry.js:47) but is not in the UI form or the stream table (views/registry.js:59-89). Reproduced in verify_d1_http.js #6: a stream of op_a accepts op_b's meterId (200).

Add a meter select in the stream form and calibration-expiry warnings in views/registry.js and the calc warnings. Allow certificate upload to entity 'meter' (data.js:190 already supports it) from the meter row. Tests: a foreign meterId gives 400; an expired calibration shows a warning.

requirements.ref: M2 sector templates (fertilizer, steel, cement, aluminium, hydrogen)
requirements.requirement: Sector monitoring-plan templates for the 5 CBAM sectors
requirements.evidence: TEMPLATES (src/api/registry.js:68-102) cover all 5 groups. The fertilizer precursor uses precursorSource 'default' with precursorTif 2814100000 (registry.js:79), whose dvStatus is 'missing' (src/refdata/initial.js:107), so resolvePrecursorSee throws (process-calc.js:297-298). Reproduced in verify_d1.js #1 with a cement process plus a fertilizer-template process in the same installation and a batch linked only to the cement process: cbam.operatorYear, tax.effective, tax.declaration(Q1) and package.build all throw. The cause is that cbam.js:31 calls tax.effective, which recomputes every process (tax.js:85) with no try/catch. Over HTTP the plain Error becomes 500 'Serverda kutilmagan xato' (src/http/app.js:113-117). The exporter dashboard calls operatorYear outside its try (src/api/admin.js:136), so it fails too. apply-template (registry.js:212-225) also bypasses checkStream.
requirements.gap: The fertilizer template cannot be calculated out of the box, and one broken process takes down the installation's tax, P_eff, CBAM, dashboard and package outputs.
requirements.fix: Point the fertilizer template precursor at precursorSource 'supplier' (requires a value) or 'internal'. Alternatively, keep 'default' but return a structured per-process error instead of throwing. Wrap per-process computation in try/catch in tax.declaration, tax.effective, cbam.operatorYear procInfo, docs/package.js build and admin.js exporter dashboard; collect errors[] in responses. Run checkStream inside apply-template. Tests: apply each template, enter 12 months, calc returns 200; with one broken sibling process, /api/cbam/operator, /api/tax/effective, /api/tax/declaration and /api/reports/package still return 200 with an errors list. The real ammonia default value still needs the TIF xlsx import.

requirements.requirement: Monitoring plans are versioned
requirements.evidence: monitoring_plans snapshot versions draft -> submitted -> approved/rejected (src/api/registry.js:302-340; schema.js:81-86). UI list and submit/decide at views/registry.js:101-104,114-116. Streams and processes stay freely editable after approval (registry.js:195-203,239-257). calc results do not record a plan version. No diff between versions. The snapshot excludes meters.

requirements.fix: Add installations.current_plan_id, set on approval. Any stream, process or meter change on an installation with an approved plan marks the plan 'outdated' (new status) and requires a new version; edits that affect verified years get 409. Store planId/planVersion in the computeProcess result (services/calc.js) and in calc_results. Add GET /api/plans/:id/diff?against=:id comparing snapshots (added, removed, changed fields) and a UI diff table. Include meters in snapshotOf. Tests: editing a stream after approval sets the plan to outdated; the result carries planVersion; the diff lists the changed EF.

requirements.requirement: Manual (web form) entry of activity data
requirements.evidence: PUT /api/processes/:id/activity (src/api/data.js:111-126) with validateEntry (data.js:21-50), audit (data.js:52-70) and verified-year lock (access.js:74-77). Monthly grid at public/js/views/data.js:32-41; tested at api.test.js:105-108,154-155. requirements.ref: M4 actual vs default selection rules
requirements.requirement: Use actual SEE only when verified actual data exists; otherwise the default with mark-up
requirements.evidence: selectSee is right (defaults.js:32-51), but 'verified' is wired wrongly in four ways. (1) saveResult stores the selection computed before verification (services/calc.js:66-73); conclude only flips status to 'verified' (verification.js:123); officialSee returns the saved JSON (calc.js:99-101); cbam.js:34 and package.js:53-62 use r.selection.applied. audit1.js #1: live basis 'actual' 0.6088, but the verified saved result, the CBAM batch and the package all apply 'default' 1.551 with verification 'positive'. verify_d1.js #6: a version saved after verification gets basis 'actual' with status draft, yet officialSee still returns the verified row (basis 'default', applied 1.41), so no path makes verified actual data official. (2) isVerified is installation-level (calc.js:21-23). audit2.js A: a process added after verification and never submitted gets basis 'actual' (0.0213 instead of default 0.36), which CBAM uses through the live fallback. (3) Streams and processes stay editable after verification (registry.js:195-203,239-250 have no lock). audit1.js #5: live seeCbam 0.6088 -> 0.9736 while still 'actual'. verify_d1.js #7: goods group changed to aluminium post-verification, still 'actual'. (4) With dvStatus 'missing' (TIF table not imported), unverified actual is applied in official outputs as 'actual_unverified' (defaults.js:45-47). api.test.js:156-157 asserts only the live calc; the package test (api.test.js:159-166) never checks goods basis.
requirements.gap: Verified actual data never reaches CBAM or the package. Unverified processes and post-verification edits can be presented as verified.
requirements.fix: (a) Inside the db.tx in verification.js conclude, for each submitted result re-run core.selectSee({actual: result.see.seeCbam, verified: true, tif: result.tif (dvStatus/dvTot), mu: result.markup}) and update calc_results.result JSON, see_applied and basis. Alternatively, have officialSee and package.build re-derive the selection whenever status === 'verified'. (b) Make verification per process-result: verified only if a calc_results row for that process-year has status 'verified' and its inputs_hash equals the current recursive inputs hash (stream config + activity + precursor hashes); otherwise use basis 'default', or 'actual_unverified' when no default exists. (c) Return 409 on process, stream or meter edits affecting a concluded year, or version the configuration (M2 versioning row), and refuse POST /api/processes/:id/results for a locked year unless a correction cycle is opened. (d) Treat dvStatus 'missing' as a blocking error for official outputs, with a warning for live calcs. Tests in api.test.js: after conclude, the cbam.operatorYear batch has basis 'actual' and see equals seeCbam, and package goods[0].basis is 'actual'; a process added later gets 'default'; a stream edit after verification gets 409.

requirements.requirement: R_t = Σ Em_f,t·P_t·k_comp,t·FX_t, with k_comp from 0.90 (year 1) to 0.95 (year 5)
requirements.evidence: The formula is at pricing.js:38-41; k_comp is indexed from start_year (tax.js:109-114, refdata initial.js:69-70). However, the base is Σ coveredEmission(computeProcess(p, baseYear)) (tax.js:105-108), and computeProcess switches to YTD months when baseYear is the current year (services/calc.js:35-44). /api/tax/revenue defaults baseYear to 2026 (finance.js:136), and the gov dashboard passes baseYear = S.year, which defaults to the current year (public/js/app.js:32; views/dashboard.js:66). verify_d1.js #2 (today 2026-10-19): base covered 153,216 t (9 months) vs 204,288 t for 12 identical months, so R_t is understated by 25% in every forecast year. Failing processes are silently skipped (tax.js:107), and the base is held constant with no per-fuel Em_f,t.
requirements.gap: When the base year is the current year, the forecast uses partial-year emissions as annual, and silently drops processes that fail.
requirements.fix: In revenueForecast, use the last complete year when baseYear is the current year, or annualize YTD (× 12/ytdMonths) and return a basis note. Return the skipped processes with their errors. Break Em down by fuel (fuelKey) so Σ_f is explicit. requirements.requirement: P_eff = Σ(Tax_paid − Rebate)/Em_covered; updated after payment is confirmed
requirements.evidence: The formula is at pricing.js:71-75. Inputs at services/tax.js:84-90 are wrong in four ways. (1) Status 'paid' (exporter-entered, unconfirmed) counts alongside 'confirmed'; exporter_admin has tax.write (rbac.js:26) and POST /api/tax/payments inserts 'paid' directly (finance.js:156-157). (2) fx is client-supplied with min 1 (finance.js:142,154); reproduced in verify_d1_http.js #7: an exporter posts fx=1, giving 200, status 'paid', fx 1. (3) Em_covered = Σ covered_t if any payment has it (tax.js:87-88), so rows with and without covered_t shrink the denominator. (4) Coverage follows the global tax.mode, not the kinds actually paid. audit1.js #2: two unconfirmed payments, one without covered_t, give P_eff = 200 USD/t vs about 1.31 correct. P_eff feeds CP_g into the CBAM deduction (cbam.js:31-35,46) and the sealed package (package.js:57,69).
requirements.gap: Unconfirmed or manipulated payments inflate P_eff, CP_g and the CBAM deduction in official documents.
requirements.fix: Use only status='confirmed' in tax.effective, package.js:69, the bulletin (reports.js:139), the gov dashboard (admin.js:167) and declaration paidUp; show pending payments separately. Take fx from refdata (fx.USD as of the payment date) for exporters and let only the tax role set or adjust fx at confirmation. Require covered_t on all payments or ignore it in favour of computed coverage. Derive coverage per payment kind through a payment -> declaration link. Add a 'rejected' status. Tests: an unconfirmed payment is excluded; an fx override is ignored; mixed covered_t falls back to computed coverage.

requirements.requirement: CP_g = SEE_cov·P_eff, s_cov = SEE_cov/SEE_CBAM; with upstream-only tax, s_cov covers only combustion
requirements.evidence: pricing.js:78-83; tax.js:91-97 (SEE_cov = covered/AL; coveredEmission 'up' = combustion only, tax.js:37-43); UI at views/tax.js:63; core.test.js:57-58. The results inherit the P_eff input defects above.

Budget codes are placeholders 'UGL-01/UGL-02' (tax.js:76). One failing process makes the whole declaration 500 (verify_d1.js #1d).

requirements.fix: Add a tax_declarations table (id, installation_id, period, variant, payload JSON, status, created_by, submitted_at, ext_ref). Add POST /api/tax/declarations (snapshot), POST /:id/submit (mock Soliq adapter -> integration_log) and GET list. Reference declaration_id in tax_payments. Add per-fuel lines (F-6.2c row), per-process error isolation and a UI list with status. Tests.

requirements.ref: M5 payment status from Tax Committee
requirements.requirement: Obtain payment status from the Tax Committee
requirements.evidence: Only a manual confirm by the 'tax' role: POST /api/tax/payments/:id/confirm (finance.js:162-169), UI button at views/tax.js:31. No integration or mock adapter retrieves status. requirements.requirement: Feedstock refund application workflow
requirements.evidence: There is only a computed potentialRefund (tax.js:71,75), labelled 'Qaytarish arizasi (s_feed)' in views/tax.js:51. A grep for refund in src finds no entity or endpoint. tax_payments.rebate_uzs is self-entered by the exporter (finance.js:142,157) and is not tied to any decided refund.

On approval record a rebate (a rebates table linked to the payment) that effectivePrice subtracts, and stop accepting self-declared rebate_uzs from exporters. Add UI in views/tax.js. Tests: approval lowers P_eff; an exporter cannot decide.

requirements.ref: Scenario S1 (upload -> AI check -> SEE -> verifier approval -> package and O3CI)
requirements.requirement: End-to-end MRV scenario ending in the document package and O3CI export
requirements.evidence: The steps exist: upload (data.js), AI-3 anomalies (api/calc.js:21), calc (services/calc.js), verification (verification.js:104-129), package and XML (reports.js:44-49). But after verifier approval the package and CBAM still apply the default SEE (audit1.js #1: package applied 1.551, basis 'default', verification 'positive'). AI document checking (AI-1) is missing. The O3CI XML is unofficial and only a download (package.js:104 comment); nothing is transmitted to O3CI.
requirements.gap: The scenario's key outcome, the verified actual SEE in the package, is wrong. The O3CI step is a file download only.
requirements.fix: Fix per the 'M4 actual vs default selection rules' row. Add an api.test.js E2E assertion that package goods.basis === 'actual' and applied === seeCbam after a positive opinion. Add an O3CI adapter stub (mock submit + integration_log) once the XSD is available.

requirements.ref: Scenario S2 (customs declaration -> batch linked to process by TIF -> EE_s and CBAM cost computed automatically)
requirements.requirement: A customs declaration arrives, the batch is linked to the process by TIF code, and EE_s and the CBAM cost are computed automatically
requirements.evidence: The customs role has batches.write (rbac.js:35). POST /api/batches and /api/batches/import accept operatorId/STIR for customs and set source 'customs' (finance.js:31-39,63-106). insertBatch auto-links via cbam.linkProcess (finance.js:45; cbam.js:11-14) only when exactly one process of the operator has that TIF. operatorYear re-links on read (cbam.js:40) and computes EE_s (cbam.js:43) and cost (cbam.js:45-53). I3 is 'Bojxona roli orqali qo'lda/CSV; API — kirish berilgach' (public/js/views/integrations.js:9). The test covers auto-link only for an exporter-entered batch (api.test.js:186-189). Fragility: one failing process anywhere in the installation makes cbam.operatorYear throw for all of the operator's batches (verify_d1.js #1b). EE_s uses the stale default after verification (M4 row). No notification is sent when a customs batch arrives.
requirements.gap: No automatic customs feed. When several processes share a TIF the batch stays unlinked with only a warning. The computation is fragile and uses the wrong SEE after verification.
requirements.fix: Add src/integrations/customs.js with a mock, and POST /api/integrations/customs/declarations (perm integrations.run or a bearer client) that upserts batches idempotently by (declaration_no, tif_code), writes integration_log and calls notify.toOperator. Isolate per-process failures in cbam.operatorYear procInfo (per-batch error). Resolve shared-TIF ambiguity with a per-installation TIF -> process mapping, or require a link from the exporter, surfaced as a task. Tests: a customs POST creates a linked batch and a notification; a broken sibling process gives a per-batch error, not 500.

requirements.ref: Scenario S3 (tax period end -> draft -> payment confirmed -> P_eff updated)
requirements.requirement: At the end of a tax period the platform prepares the declaration draft; once payment is confirmed, P_eff is updated
requirements.evidence: There is no tax-period deadline and no automatic draft: notify.deadlines (notify.js:25-36) lists only MRV deadlines, and the draft is on demand only (finance.js:124). P_eff is recomputed per request but already includes unconfirmed payments (tax.js:84), so confirmation changes nothing. The confirm endpoint sends no notification (finance.js:162-169; verify_d1_http.js #8b).
requirements.gap: The scenario is neither triggered by the period end nor gated on confirmation.
requirements.fix: Add quarterly tax deadlines to notify.deadlines. Add a period-end job or on-login check that creates tax_declarations drafts and notifies exporters. Count only confirmed payments in P_eff (F-6.4 row). On confirm, notify the operator and record P_eff before and after in the audit log. E2E test in api.test.js: an unconfirmed payment leaves P_eff unchanged; after confirm, P_eff changes and a notification exists.

requirements.ref: Report form: enterprise annual emissions report (korxona yillik emissiya hisoboti)
requirements.requirement: Annual emissions report per enterprise or installation
requirements.evidence: GET /api/reports/annual (reports.js:50-56) -> P.annualXlsx (package.js:194-201); UI button at views/docs.js:24,41. The 'SEE CBAM' column is filled with g.applied (package.js:196-197), i.e. the applied, possibly default, SEE under an actual-SEE header. 'To'g'ridan-to'g'ri' is attrDir, and installation-level national MRV totals (DirEm, electricity) from /api/installations/:id/summary (api/calc.js:63-87) are not included. It is built on P.build, so it inherits the stale selection after verification and fails entirely when any process throws (verify_d1.js #1e).

requirements.fix: In annualXlsx add separate seeCbam (actual), applied and basis columns, and an 'Inshoot' sheet with national.direct/indirect and CBAM totals. Extract the summary logic from api/calc.js into services/calc.installationSummary and reuse it. Add per-process try/catch in P.build with an errors sheet. Test: the annual xlsx for a verified year shows basis 'actual' and the national totals.

requirements.ref: Report form: carbon tax quarterly bulletin (Strategiya 5.4)
requirements.requirement: Quarterly carbon-tax bulletin
requirements.evidence: GET /api/reports/bulletin (reports.js:136-148), UI at views/tax.js:38-40 (dashboard.gov only). It sums payments with status IN ('paid','confirmed'), including unconfirmed exporter entries. goods_group is selected (reports.js:138-139) but never used, so there is no sector breakdown despite the header comment 'tarmoqlar kesimida'. estimatedDueUzs is the sum of the annual 'up' declaration per installation (YTD for the current year) with errors swallowed (reports.js:145), so the collection ratio mixes periods and silently drops failing installations. No export format.
requirements.gap: The figures include unconfirmed payments, there is no breakdown by sector or quarter due, failures are silently omitted, and the bulletin cannot be exported.
requirements.fix: Count confirmed payments only and show pending separately. Group by quarter × goods_group (and region), applying privacy.min_group. Compute the estimated due per quarter with tax.declaration(quarter) and return an errors list. Add format=xlsx via writeXlsx. Tests.

requirements.requirement: Annual carbon-tax report

Include totals by kind (up/down) and quarter; by sector and region (aggregated, at least the minimum group size); confirmed vs pending; refunds and rebates; the P_eff distribution across installations (aggregated); collection vs the revenueForecast with k_comp. Produce xlsx with writeXlsx. Add a UI button in views/tax.js. Tests.

requirements.ref: Report form: 'Birgalikda mavjudlik eslatmasi' (excise and carbon-tax burden by fuel)
requirements.requirement: Coexistence note: excise and carbon-tax burden per fuel
requirements.evidence: GET /api/reports/coexistence (reports.js:150-160) in json and xlsx; UI button at views/tax.js:20,68. Each refdata fuel gets a row with carbon tax per unit and per t. Excise is matched by key substring (reports.js:154), and only excise.petrol_ai80 exists (initial.js:86), so the excise and implicit-price columns are empty for diesel, LPG, mazut, coal and natural gas. The ad valorem gas excise (12%) is only a note string (reports.js:159), with no amount.

sections.section: D2-modules-M6-M10 (TZ-2 §7 lines 193-213: M6-M10, 4 user scenarios, 5 report forms). Verified adversarially against code. Probes ran on a fresh seed in C:\Users\TZ-IG4\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\d--uzcarbon-uzcarbon\d8329894-097c-4fd1-beec-af458ec98aab\scratchpad\v2seed, with the app on a random port (never 3000). Probe scripts: scratchpad\v2\p1.js, p2.js, p3.js. node --test on the 4 test files: 38/38 pass.

requirements.requirement: N_cert = Σ_s m_s·(SEE − BM·CF_t) − Σ_s m_s·CP_g·FX_EUR/P_CBAM; Cost = max(0, N_cert)·P_CBAM. The max(0) applies to the summed N_cert (declarant level).
requirements.evidence: pricing.js:90-97 cbamExact is correct for an array. But cbam.js:48 calls it with batches:[single] and cbam.js:52 (simplified path) floors each batch with eu = Math.max(0, grossEur − ruzEur). cbam.js:66 and :72 then sum the per-batch floors. All batches of one process share SEE and CP_g, so the error appears only across processes or installations of one operator or importer. Realistic probe (p3.js): ETS 60 €; op_fert 2026 plus one 30,000 t proc_ammonia batch (actual_unverified SEE 2.06, CP_g 4.07 USD/t). The ammonia batch has gross 92,713 € and ruz 101,804 €, so it is floored to 0. totals.euEur = 218,212 €, while the TZ aggregate max(0, Σgross − Σruz) = 209,122 €. For importer imp_f1: per-batch sum 152,619 € vs aggregate 143,528 €.
requirements.gap: Floors are applied per batch, so the liability is overstated whenever one good's Art. 9 deduction exceeds its gross. This happens in early years (2026-27 signal years) or under tax.mode down2. The byImporter figures inherit the error.
requirements.fix: Change cbam.operatorYear (cbam.js:39-75) to store unfloored per-batch grossCerts and deductionCerts. Compute nCert = Σgross − Σded and cost = max(0, nCert)·pEts per importer (the declarant) and per year. Set totals.euEur = Σ over importers. Keep the per-batch eu only as an informational 'allocated' share, pro rata. Tests: (1) core test where cbamExact gets two batches of mixed sign and cost equals max(0, sum); (2) service test that adds a second-process batch with ruz > gross and asserts totals.euEur === max(0, Σgross − Σruz) for a single importer.

requirements.requirement: The exact formula needs BM_g for each good. It must be used whenever a benchmark is known.
requirements.evidence: initial.js:98 creates every tif.* entry with bm:null. The import path exists: admin.js:26 detects a 'benchmark'/'bm' column, admin.js:49 maps it, and refdata.js:33 validates it as numeric. Probe p1.js: all 2026 batches of all 3 operators report method 'simplified', so the exact path never runs on seeded data.
requirements.gap: No CBAM benchmark values are loaded, so F-6.5a is unreachable in operation. Its only coverage is the core unit test (core.test.js:61).
requirements.fix: Load the EU CBAM benchmarks per CN code through POST /api/refdata/import-tif with a bm column, then approve them through the two-person flow. Add an acceptance test that a process whose tif has bm set produces method 'exact' in cbam.operatorYear and that N_cert matches a hand calculation.

requirements.requirement: Scenario/simplified formula, used when the benchmark is unknown.
requirements.evidence: pricing.js:100-102 cbamSimplified. Used in cbam.js:51 (batch, net of the national deduction) and in pricing.js:109-116 scenarioYear. Probe p1.js, op_cement 2026: grossEur 160,892 € = EE 85,809 t × 75 € × 0.025. Acceptance test A.2 (acceptance.test.js:31) and api.test.js:190-192 (2034 gross 43.73 mln USD) pass.

requirements.ref: M6 R_UZ = Σ m_s·CP_g, Burden_total; CP_g from P_eff
requirements.requirement: R_UZ (money retained in Uzbekistan) and total burden. CP_g = SEE_cov·P_eff, where P_eff is the carbon price actually paid (CBAM Art. 9).
requirements.evidence: cbam.js:46 sets ruzEur = net_t·cpUsd·usdToEur, with cpUsd taken from tax.effective (tax.js:81-99). tax.js:84 counts payments with status IN ('paid','confirmed'). finance.js:156-157 inserts exporter-entered payments as 'paid'. tax.js:87-88 uses Σcovered_t, the exporter-declared value, whenever any payment states it. Probe p3.js, abuse case: metall_admin posts 121,000,000 UZS with coveredT=1 for inst_steel 2026. Result: P_eff = 10,000 USD/t, CP_g = 3,134 USD/t, steel EU cost 176,778 € → 0 €, ruzEur 69.8 M €. Probe p3.js, honest case: sement_admin records a Q3 payment equal to Q1 and leaves the optional 'Qamrab olingan emissiya' field empty (views/tax.js:36). P_eff rises from 5.00 to 7.17 USD/t (+43%), because the denominator still counts only the Q1+Q2 covered_t.
requirements.gap: Any exporter can erase its CBAM liability, or inflate R_UZ/CP_g in documents, with an unconfirmed payment and a tiny or missing covered_t. An honest partial entry of covered_t also corrupts P_eff. R_UZ is never capped at the tax actually paid.
requirements.fix: (1) In tax.effective, count only status='confirmed' payments. (2) Do not use exporter covered_t as the denominator. Use coveredEmission for the periods actually paid (computeProcess with the payment quarter months), or require covered_t to be set and confirmed by the Tax role (add a confirmed_covered_t column at /api/tax/payments/:id/confirm). Clamp it to [0.5, 1.0]× the computed covered emission. (3) In cbam.operatorYear, cap Σ ruzEur per installation-year at Σ(confirmed amount − rebate)/fx·usdToEur. (4) API tests: an unconfirmed payment gives deduction 0; coveredT=1 does not change P_eff; a Q3 payment without coveredT leaves P_eff unchanged.

requirements.requirement: Certificate price linked to the EU ETS (EUR/t) and the EUR conversion.
requirements.evidence: cbam.js:23 reads pEts = ets.price_eur and usdToEur = fx.USD/fx.EUR from the year-end snapshot. Values are at initial.js:77-81. Updated through admin.js:219-225 (I9 manual) and admin.js:197-217 (CBU sync). Probe p1.js: after ets.price_eur=150, operatorYear pEts became 150. One simplification: a single year-end value is used, not the quarterly or weekly auction average. Who may change the value is a hole, covered in the 'ETS manual entry bypasses approval' row.

requirements.ref: M6 policy signal (national tax > EU effective price)
requirements.requirement: Show both parts by year. In early years, flag when the national tax exceeds the EU effective price.
requirements.evidence: pricing.js:109-116 sets signal = ruz > gross and extraBurden. cbam.js:102 returns signals. Rendered at views/cbam.js:51 (banner) and :53 (pill). Probe p1.js, proc_cement base 2025: signals [2026, 2027], consistent with TZ Ilova A.2.

requirements.ref: M6 2026–2034 scenario: EU ETS price parameter
requirements.requirement: The scenario runs on the EU ETS price. Its default should follow the maintained reference price.
requirements.evidence: The user can vary the price: finance.js:115 accepts etsUsd and views/cbam.js:36 has the field, so the scenario function works. But cbam.js:97 falls back to ets.reference_usd, which no integration updates; admin.js:221 writes only ets.price_eur. The UI pre-fills 87 and always sends it (views/cbam.js:36,47). Probe p1.js: after ets.price_eur=150, the scenario still returned pEts 87 and an unchanged 2030 total (1,890,223 USD), while operatorYear used 150. The platform also shows two inconsistent prices at once: 75 € ≈ 89.9 USD in the calculator vs 87 USD in scenario, CCI and gov risk.
requirements.gap: The scenario default is disconnected from the ETS price IMV enters, and there are two price sources. The S4 consequence is listed separately.
requirements.fix: Use one source. Derive pEtsUsd = ets.price_eur·fx.EUR/fx.USD from the snapshot (or have /api/integrations/ets also write ets.reference_usd), and use it in cbam.scenario, admin.js:129 and admin.js:170. In views/cbam.js, pre-fill from GET /api/refdata?prefix=ets. and send etsUsd only when the user edits it. Test: after systemSet ets.price_eur, scenario.pEts changes.

requirements.requirement: Export volume growth is applied per year from the base year.
requirements.evidence: pricing.js:124-131 computes k = (1+exportGrowth)^(y−y0). finance.js:116 validates the range (−0.5..1) and views/cbam.js:37 has the field. But cbam.js:98 hard-codes baseYear: 2026, while the default base year is 2025 (finance.js:119, views/cbam.js:35). With base 2025 and +5%/yr, 2026 gets k=1 (equal to 2025) instead of 1.05, so the whole path is shifted one year.
requirements.gap: Off-by-one-year growth path for the default base year 2025.
requirements.fix: Pass baseYear: o.baseYear to core.scenarioTable at cbam.js:98, giving k = (1+g)^(y−baseYear). Add a test: baseYear 2025, growth 0.1, rows[0] (2026) EE equals 1.1×base.

requirements.requirement: The SEE reduction path is applied per year.
requirements.evidence: pricing.js:128 applies the factor (1+seeChange)^(y−y0). finance.js:116 validates the range (−0.5..0.5) and views/cbam.js:38 has the field. It has the same anchor bug as export volume: cbam.js:98 hard-codes baseYear 2026, so the first year of decline is lost for base 2025.
requirements.gap: Off-by-one-year SEE decline path for base year 2025.
requirements.fix: Same change as the export-volume row (pass o.baseYear). Add a test with seeChange −0.02 and base 2025: 2026 EE = 0.98×base.

requirements.ref: M6 scenario: base EE and actual-vs-default basis
requirements.requirement: The scenario base must reflect the SEE that CBAM will actually apply (default until verified), or let the user choose.
requirements.evidence: cbam.js:90 uses r.see.seeCbam (actual) whenever it is finite and ignores selection.applied. For unverified exporters it therefore uses unverified actual SEE (cement 2025: 0.618 actual vs 1.41 default before verification). The base mass comes only from base-year batches (cbam.js:88-89). The UI base year select offers only 2024-2026 (views/cbam.js:35). Probe p1.js: proc_ammonia, which has no exports, gives ee=0 and exportT=0, an all-zero table.
requirements.gap: The forecast understates cost for unverified exporters, there is no basis switch, and processes without exports give an empty forecast.
requirements.fix: Add basis=applied|actual|default to /api/cbam/scenario (finance.js:114-120), defaulting to applied, and return both series so the UI shows the gap. Allow base years up to the current year. Hide processes without CBAM exports in the picker, or show 'no exports in base year'.

requirements.requirement: CBAM payment broken down by EU importer (the CBAM declarant).
requirements.evidence: cbam.js:63-69 groups by importerId and returns name, EORI, batches, netT, ee, euEur and ruzEur. Shown at views/cbam.js:31 and views/dashboard.js:56-60. euEur per importer is a sum of per-batch floors. Probe p3.js, imp_f1: 152,619 € vs the TZ aggregate 143,528 €.
requirements.gap: The breakdown exists, but the per-importer amount is not max(0, N_cert) for that declarant, which is exactly the level where F-6.5a applies.
requirements.fix: Compute the importer cost from unfloored sums, as in the F-6.5a aggregation row. Add a service test on importer totals with mixed-sign batches.

requirements.requirement: Compute the saving from using actual (verified) data instead of default values (TZ §5.7 last sentence, M6).
requirements.evidence: cbam.js:55-60: euDefaultEur uses the simplified formula with no national deduction (comment at :56), while euActualEur is simplified minus ruzEur, even when method='exact'. Probe p1.js, cement 2026: savingEur 131,856 €. Of that, 35,980 € (the whole ruzEur) comes only from the asymmetric deduction; the consistent saving is about 95,876 €. Shown as a KPI at views/cbam.js:22 and dashboard.js:32. After verification the saving is still never realised, because of the stale-basis defect.
requirements.gap: Default and actual are compared on inconsistent bases (deduction dropped only for default, method ignored), which overstates the benefit by the full R_UZ.
requirements.fix: Compute both variants with the batch's method (exact or simplified) and the same Art. 9 deduction, or show 'without deduction' for both. Return a potential saving (unverified) and a realised saving (verified). Add unit tests for both methods.

requirements.ref: M4/M6/M7 verified actual SEE must be applied after verification
requirements.requirement: Selection rule: once data is verified, the actual SEE replaces the default in the CBAM cost, the package, the annual report and the importer template.
requirements.evidence: calc.js:66-77 saveResult stores selection and basis as computed at save time, which is unverified, so basis 'default'. verification.js:123 only sets status='verified', locked=1. officialSee (calc.js:99-103) and package.build (package.js:53-54) read that stale JSON. Probe p1.js on seed inst_cement 2025 (verified positive): officialSee has status verified, basis 'default', applied 1.41; live computeProcess has basis 'actual', 0.6182; the package goods show basis 'default', applied 1.41, with verification 'positive'. Re-saving does not help: probe p2.js shows POST /api/processes/proc_cement/results creates v2 with basis 'actual' as a draft, but officialSee orders 'verified' first. tests/api.test.js:156-157 checks only the live calc.
requirements.gap: Verified exporters keep paying default values in the CBAM calculator, package, annual report, Communication template and gov aggregates.
requirements.fix: Add a helper in services/calc.js: effectiveSelection(result, status) returns {applied: see.seeCbam, basis: 'actual'} when status==='verified' and seeCbam is finite. Use it in officialSee, package.build and admin.aggregate. In verification conclude (verification.js:121-125), also update see_applied, basis and the result JSON selection. This does not touch the signed payload, which covers inputsHash and seeCbam. API test: after conclude, /api/reports/package goods[0].basis === 'actual' and the cbam batch see equals seeCbam.

requirements.requirement: Sensitivity analysis on demand ±5–10%, collectability ±3–5 p.p., exchange rate, and EU ETS price scenarios 70/87/100/130, linked to the M6 scenarios.
requirements.evidence: cbam.js:99-101 varies ee by ±5/10% (demand), pEts by −20/+15/+50% and sCov by −50%. etsScenarios uses ets.scenarios_usd [70,87,100,130] (initial.js:82) but returns only the 2034 total. Rendered at views/cbam.js:55-57.
requirements.gap: There is no exchange-rate or collectability (k_comp ±3–5 p.p.) sensitivity, and no full 2026–2034 path per ETS scenario.
requirements.fix: Add an fx variation (USD/EUR and UZS) to core.sensitivity in cbam.scenario, and a k_comp ±0.03/±0.05 variation in tax.revenueForecast. Return rows per ETS scenario for all years. Render them in views/cbam.js.

requirements.ref: M7 tax payment certificate (amount, period, fuel/process, FX)

Optionally add tax_payments.fuel_key or payment_lines(fuel_key, q, rate). Add GET /api/reports/tax-certificate?installationId&year&format=html|docx|json (docs.read). Add CP_g per good to toDocx. Test the fields.

requirements.ref: M7/S3 certificate and P_eff based on Tax-Committee-confirmed payments
requirements.requirement: Payment status comes from the Tax Committee. The certificate and P_eff update after confirmation.
requirements.evidence: finance.js:156-157 inserts exporter payments as 'paid'. tax.js:84, tax.js:63, package.js:69, admin.js:167 and reports.js:139 all include 'paid'. In the confirm handler, call notify.toOperator(p.operator_id, 'tax', ...). Add an API test that P_eff changes only after confirm.

requirements.requirement: The package describes how embedded emissions were calculated.
requirements.evidence: package.js:64 builds 'methods' as the de-duplicated trace (id/label/formula), capped at 40. HTML :148 lists the F-formulas, and the annualXlsx 'Usullar' sheet is at :198. toDocx (:157-173) and toXml (:93-121) have no method section.

requirements.fix: In package.build, add methodology[] per process from the streams table (type, method, fuel_key/material, ef_source, source_level, precursor_source, supplier SEE) and the approved monitoring_plans version and date. Render it in HTML, DOCX, XML and the Communication template.

requirements.requirement: The package includes the verifier's opinion.

requirements.requirement: Reference/link to the installation record in the EU O3CI.
requirements.evidence: Only IDs are present: package.js:76-77 o3ciOperatorId/o3ciInstallationId, shown in HTML :144, DOCX :161 and XLSX :180. views/integrations.js:7 says 'XML export ready; official XSD and connection once access is granted'.

requirements.requirement: Data template for the EU importer in the EU CBAM Communication template format.

requirements.ref: M7 importer package scoped to that importer (confidentiality)
requirements.requirement: The package shared with an EU importer must contain only that importer's consignments.
requirements.evidence: reports.js:103-108 openShare and :117-124 the importer cabinet call P.build(s, row.installation_id, row.year) and ignore row.importer_id. package.js:73 includes every batch with EORI and country. Probe p2.js: kimyo_admin created a share link for imp_f1 (inst_fert 2025); the package's batches contain EORIs RO100000000003 and BG100000000004, the competitor importer imp_f2's declarations, masses and EE.

Make importerId required in POST /api/share (reports.js:80). Add a test that the share package holds only that importer's EORI.

requirements.requirement: Electronically signed PDF.
requirements.evidence: package.js:140 says 'PDF: Ctrl+P → Save as PDF', and the docs.js:22 'Ko'rish / PDF' button opens HTML. src/docs has only zip, xlsx, docx, csv and package. A grep for pdf in src/public finds only a MIME type (data.js:183) and those UI strings. reports.js:38 formats are json|xml|html|docx|xlsx.
requirements.gap: No server-generated PDF exists, so nothing can be signed or attached.
