Add format=pdf to reports.js:38/42. Add a PAdES/E-IMZO signature later. Test: %PDF header, valid xref, page count.

requirements.requirement: The document carries a QR code pointing to the verification URL/hash.
requirements.evidence: A grep for qr/qrcode in src and public finds nothing. The verify URL is printed as text only (reports.js:31, package.js:153). REJA.md:558 admits 'QR-kod yo'q'.
requirements.gap: There is no QR encoder and no QR in HTML, DOCX or PDF.
requirements.fix: Implement src/docs/qr.js (byte mode, ECC M, versions 1-10, Reed-Solomon) returning a module matrix. Render it as inline SVG in toHtml, as PNG media in DOCX, and in the PDF. Test against known vectors.

requirements.requirement: Legally valid electronic signature on the document package.
requirements.evidence: package.js:85-90 seal = SHA-256 of the JSON plus an HMAC with the platform key, labelled 'mock-ERI'. reports.js:127-132 only checks that the hash was issued.
requirements.gap: It is not a qualified E-IMZO signature and does not identify the signer.
requirements.fix: Implement the I10 E-IMZO adapter: client-side signing of the hash by an exporter_admin, server-side PKCS#7 verification, and storage with the package. Until then, add signer identity to the seal (see the docs.sign row).

requirements.requirement: Only authorised exporter signatories issue signed packages, and the package identifies the signer.
requirements.evidence: rbac.js:26 grants docs.sign to exporter_admin, but no route checks it (grep: only rbac.js:26). reports.js:44 issues sealed and registered packages on a GET with perm docs.read. Probe p2.js: 'sement' (specialist) and 'verifikator' both got 200 with a sealed package registered as 'package.issue'. The seal payload (package.js:85-90) has no signer.
requirements.gap: Any reader, including the verifier, can mint 'signed' packages that the public verify endpoint confirms. The signature is not tied to a responsible person.
requirements.fix: Split the endpoint: GET preview (docs.read, unsealed, not registered) and POST /api/reports/package/issue (docs.sign, TOTP re-auth as in verification.js:108-113) that seals and registers. Put signer {userId, login, role, at} in the seal payload and audit entry. Test that a specialist or verifier gets 403 on issue.

requirements.requirement: Package available as XML and JSON.
requirements.evidence: reports.js:33-34 renders json and xml. package.js:93-121 toXml (CBAMOperatorPackage with Goods, CarbonPrice, Verification, Consignments and Seal). api.test.js:166 checks that xml/html/docx/xlsx return 200. The XML uses a custom schema; the O3CI XSD is pending (I1).

requirements.requirement: Every sealed document the platform hands out can be verified through the printed verify URL (the QR target).
requirements.evidence: Only issue() (reports.js:25-29), used by /api/reports/package, writes the 'package.issue' audit record that /api/public/verify looks up (reports.js:127-132). /api/reports/annual (reports.js:55), openShare (reports.js:107, used by /share/:token and /api/share/:token/package) and the importer cabinet (reports.js:121) seal with P.seal without registering, yet the HTML prints the verify URL (package.js:153; reports.js:109 passes it). Probe p2.js: share-link package hash → {issued:false}; annual report hash → {issued:false}; /api/reports/package hash → {issued:true}.
requirements.gap: Documents sent to EU importers through the share link, and the annual report, fail their own authenticity check.
requirements.fix: Route all sealed outputs through one issue() helper that writes 'package.issue' (actor = user, or 'share:<id>'). Better: freeze the sealed package when POST /api/share runs, storing the hash and JSON in share_links, so the importer always gets the registered document. Add tests that the share and annual hashes verify as issued:true.

requirements.requirement: Registry of accredited verifiers (accreditation, validity, scope).
requirements.evidence: schema.js:87-90 verifiers(name, accreditation_no, accredited_until, sectors). registry.js:292 GET (any authenticated user, active computed from accredited_until) and registry.js:293-299 POST (verifiers.manage = imv). The UI form is in views/registry.js:39,45.
requirements.gap: There is no update, suspend or withdraw endpoint, no accreditation body, no structured ISO 14065 scope (goods groups), and no status history. 'sectors' is free text and never enforced.
requirements.fix: Add PUT /api/verifiers/:id and POST /api/verifiers/:id/suspend (verifiers.manage, audited). Add columns accreditation_body, scope_groups (JSON of GROUPS), status, suspended_at. Test that a suspended verifier cannot be assigned or conclude.

requirements.requirement: The exporter assigns an accredited verifier to an installation-year.
requirements.evidence: verification.js:55-67: accreditation expiry is checked at assignment only (:60); one open verification per installation-year (:61); the verifier is notified (:65). Read-only scoped access is in access.js:46-51.
requirements.gap: Scope ⊇ the installation's goods groups is not checked. There is no impartiality/COI declaration. Accreditation is not re-checked at conclude (:104-129). After a negative opinion a new verifier can be assigned immediately (opinion shopping), because only open verifications block.
requirements.fix: At assignment, require scope_groups ⊇ the goods groups of the installation's processes and record verifications.coi_declared_at, accepted by the verifier. At conclude, re-check accredited_until and status. Flag re-assignment after a negative opinion for IMV approval. Add tests.

requirements.requirement: The verifier can raise information requests to the exporter.
requirements.evidence: verification.js:70-81 adds kind 'request' with status open and notifies the operator (:79). The exporter responds at :83-93. UI at views/verification.js:40,43-44. Minor: the verifier is not notified when the exporter responds.

requirements.requirement: The verifier records nonconformities, and they block a positive opinion until closed.
requirements.evidence: verification.js:73 kind 'nonconformity'. verification.js:114-115 blocks a positive or qualified opinion while open NCs exist. Covered by api.test.js:140-148.

requirements.requirement: The exporter corrects data in response to findings, and the correction is traceable.
requirements.evidence: verification.js:83-93: the response is free text only. Corrections are technically possible (data stays editable until conclusion; a new result version can be saved and resubmitted, api/calc.js:24-28, 50-60), but nothing links a finding to the corrected calc_result version or changed activity rows. Close (:94-101) does not check the verification status.
requirements.gap: Corrections are not tied to data or result versions, so the verifier cannot see what changed for a given finding.
requirements.fix: Add findings.correction_result_id and an optional evidence document id, set on respond. Show a diff via /api/results/compare in the finding. Reject close when v.status='concluded'. Add tests.

requirements.requirement: Verification workflow conforming to ISO 14065 / 14064-3.
requirements.evidence: Statuses are only assigned → in_progress → concluded (views/verification.js:6). Finding kinds are request, nonconformity, comment and sample (verification.js:73).
requirements.gap: Missing: strategic analysis and risk assessment, verification and sampling plan, materiality threshold and misstatement quantification, site-visit record, independent technical review by a second person, level of assurance, and an opinion template.
requirements.fix: Add a verification_steps table (plan, risk_assessment, site_visit, materiality {threshold, misstatement}, technical_review {reviewer_id ≠ signer}) and require completion before conclude. Add a checklist UI. Test that conclude fails without a plan and an independent review.

requirements.requirement: The verifier issues the final opinion and signs it.
requirements.evidence: verification.js:104-129: opinion positive/qualified/negative, TOTP re-auth (:109-113), and a signPayload HMAC 'mock-ERI' over the results' inputsHash and seeCbam (:17-19, :119-120). Results are locked (:123) and the operator notified (:127). UI at views/verification.js:46-50. TOTP is skipped when totp_enabled=0 (:109).
requirements.gap: The signature is a platform HMAC, not the verifier's qualified E-IMZO signature.
requirements.fix: Integrate I10 E-IMZO signing of the payload hash by the verifier and store the PKCS#7. Make TOTP mandatory for conclude regardless of totp_enabled.

requirements.requirement: Data of a verified period is locked.
requirements.evidence: Activity writes are locked: assertNotLocked at data.js:114,132,167 and ai.js:70; probe p2.js PUT activity → 409. But stream and process configuration are not: registry.js:239-250 PUT /api/streams/:id and :195-203 PUT /api/processes/:id have no lock check. Probe p2.js on verified inst_cement 2025: PUT st_c_gas fuelKey → 200, and the live 2025 SEE changed from 0.61821 to 0.60408; PUT proc_cement tifCode → 200. POST /api/processes/proc_cement/results for 2025 → 200 (new draft v2).
requirements.gap: After verification, the exporter can still change stream parameters (fuel, EF source, carbon content, supplier SEE) and process TIF/goods group. This alters live calculations, tax.effective and batch linking for the verified year.
requirements.fix: In stream and process PUT/DELETE, block changes when any concluded positive or qualified verification exists for the installation (or version streams by valid_from/valid_to, so past years keep their configuration). Reject saveResult for locked years unless a correction cycle is opened. Add tests.

requirements.requirement: Dynamics of specific embedded emissions (SEE) over time.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:127 computes only the previous-year seePrev, shown in the 'Oldingi yil' column at views/dashboard.js:44. The chart at dashboard.js:38 plots monthly direct emissions from /api/ai/forecast (dirEm, dashboard.js:22), not SEE.
requirements.gap: There is no multi-year or monthly SEE series.
requirements.fix: Add seeSeries to /api/dashboard/exporter: per process, applied and actual SEE for years [year−4..year] (officialSee) and monthly SEE (computeProcess with months=[m]). Render it with line() in dashboard.js.

requirements.requirement: Compare the company's SEE with the benchmark (EU benchmark or sector).
requirements.evidence: admin.js:132 returns bm, but dashboard.js:35-37 renders only actual vs default. core.rcci (pricing.js:137-140) is never called (grep). bm is null everywhere (initial.js:98). There is no peer average.
requirements.gap: No benchmark or RCCI is shown, and no benchmark data is loaded.
requirements.fix: Render a BM bar and RCCI = (SEE_firm − SEE_EU)·P/p_g via core.rcci per process. Add a sector peer average when the group has at least privacy.min_group companies. Load benchmarks through the TIF import bm column.

requirements.requirement: The exporter sees its CBAM cost.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:136-142 uses cbam.operatorYear totals and byImporter. KPIs at dashboard.js:31-32 and table at :56-60. The values inherit the M6 defects (stale basis, P_eff, per-batch floor).

requirements.ref: M9 exporter panel: CCI (share of export price)
requirements.requirement: CCI = SEE·P/p_g (TZ §6.6; no CF term).
requirements.evidence: admin.js:129-133 computes CCI inline as seeCbam·ets.reference_usd·(1−cf)/export_price_usd, with cf = cbam.cf.<year> ?? 0; core.cci (pricing.js:134) is unused. Shown at dashboard.js:46. For 2026+ it multiplies by (1−CF), which the TZ formula does not have; for pre-2026 years cf=0. P comes from ets.reference_usd, which the ETS update never changes. It uses unverified actual SEE, not applied SEE. Processes without export_price_usd (proc_ammonia) show '—'.
requirements.gap: Formula deviates from the TZ (CF factor applied inconsistently by year), the price source is stale, and the SEE basis is wrong.
requirements.fix: Use core.cci with P from the single ETS source and the applied SEE. Return both CCI (TZ formula, full price) and CCI_eff = CCI·(1−CF_t) for t ≥ 2026. Add a unit test.

requirements.ref: M9 government panel: carbon tax revenue
requirements.requirement: Carbon tax revenue on the government dashboard.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:167 sums tax_payments with status IN ('paid','confirmed'); KPI at dashboard.js:75. Probe p2.js 2026: taxPaidUzs 20.22 bn, which includes the unconfirmed seeded Q2 rows. The forecast is at finance.js:135-138 and tax.js:102-119 (table at dashboard.js:84-86).
requirements.gap: Revenue includes self-declared, unconfirmed payments, and there is no breakdown by quarter or kind.
requirements.fix: Count confirmed payments only, show 'declared, awaiting confirmation' separately, and add a breakdown by quarter and kind.

requirements.ref: M9 government panel: CBAM risk by sector
requirements.requirement: CBAM risk broken down by sector.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:157-161 bySector has ee but no cost. The dashboard.js:78-80 sector table shows emissions, export and verified share only. Min-group hiding applies to every caller. Probe p2.js: imv (scope all) sees all 3 sectors hidden.

requirements.fix: In aggregate(), add riskUsd = ee·P·(1−CF_t) (0 for pre-2026) and risk100Usd per sector. Apply min-group hiding only for aggregate or public callers. Add the columns in dashboard.js.

requirements.ref: M9 government panel: CBAM risk by company
requirements.requirement: CBAM risk broken down by company.
requirements.evidence: Downgraded from 'missing'. Per-company CBAM cost exists for IMV: /api/cbam/operator/:id (finance.js:109-113, cbam.read, scope all) and the operator selector in views/cbam.js:16. Probe p2.js: imv → 200 (op_steel euEur 176,778 €); gov_analyst → 403. But /api/dashboard/gov (admin.js:164-175) has no per-company list, and tax/ecology lack cbam.read. The only per-company table is the AI-9 risk score (dashboard.js:87-90), which has no money amount.

requirements.fix: Add byCompany to /api/dashboard/gov for scope-'all' roles: name, STIR, EE, CBAM cost (cbam.operatorYear totals.euEur), 100% exposure and default share. Render a sortable table. Add a test that gov_analyst and energy do not receive it.

requirements.ref: M9 government panel: NDC indicator (GHG per GDP vs 2010)
requirements.requirement: NDC indicator: emissions per unit of GDP relative to 2010.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:174 returns only baseYear, target2030 and a note that GDP and inventory integration (I7, I11) is needed. dashboard.js:91 shows text only. Reference data has only ndc.base_year and ndc.target_reduction_2030 (initial.js:89-90). A grep for gdp/yaim finds no calculation.
requirements.gap: No intensity, trend or progress-to-target is calculated.
requirements.fix: Add refdata ndc.gdp.<year> and ndc.ghg.<year> (two-person rule until I7/I11). Compute intensity_y = ghg/gdp and reduction = 1 − intensity_y/intensity_2010 against 0.35. Render a line chart.

requirements.ref: M9 government CBAM risk for pre-2026 years
requirements.requirement: CBAM risk must reflect the transitional period (no payment before 2026).
requirements.evidence: admin.js:170 cf = cbam.cf.<year> ?? 0, and no cbam.cf.2025 exists (initial.js:19). Probe p2.js, 2025: cbamRiskUsd = cbamRisk100Usd = 35,612,846 USD, while cbam.operatorYear treats 2025 as transitional with zero cost (cbam.js:22; probe p1.js euEur 0). The KPI at dashboard.js:74 is labelled 'CBAM xavfi (2025)'.
requirements.gap: The government dashboard reports a full 100% CBAM liability for transitional years.
requirements.fix: For years before 2026, set cbamRiskUsd = 0 and label it 'transitional', with an optional 'at 2026 rate' exposure. Use the single ETS source.

requirements.requirement: Public dashboard with aggregated data only.
requirements.evidence: admin.js:177-181 GET /api/public/summary (auth:false) returns sector aggregates with min-group hiding (privacy.min_group=3). views/public.js:7, linked from the login page. Minor: no caching or rate limit on an unauthenticated endpoint that recomputes all processes.

requirements.ref: M9/M10 company-level data exposure to aggregate-scope roles
requirements.requirement: Analyst and Energy roles see aggregates only (access.js:2-7).
requirements.evidence: ai.js:98-101 GET /api/ai/risk accepts dashboard.gov or tax.read and excludes only operator scope. Probe p2.js: 'tahlilchi' (gov_analyst) and 'energetika' (energy) both got 200 with all 3 company names, STIRs and scores.
requirements.gap: Privacy and commercial-secrecy breach for aggregate-only roles.
requirements.fix: In ai.js:99, allow only A.scopeOf(user)==='all'. Add an API test that gov_analyst and energy get 403. The gov UI already tolerates risk=null (dashboard.js:66,87).

requirements.requirement: Reference table of TIF TN (CN) codes with versions and validity.
requirements.evidence: initial.js:96-113 holds 14 sample codes (sample:true; 5 with dvStatus 'missing'). admin.js:84-95 imports xlsx/csv as proposals for second-person approval (bulk approval at admin.js:75-81). UI at views/refdata.js. No CBAM_TIF_codes xlsx is in the repo (glob).
requirements.gap: The full table (~285 codes) is not loaded.

requirements.ref: Report form 3: quarterly carbon tax bulletin (Strategy 5.4)
requirements.requirement: Quarterly carbon tax bulletin.

requirements.requirement: Annual carbon tax report.

requirements.ref: Report form 5: coexistence note (excise vs carbon tax by fuel)

requirements.requirement: IPCC defaults (gas 56, diesel 74, petrol 73, LPG 63, mazut 77, coal 98 kg CO2/GJ) are kept as reference data. National NCV/EF for Uzbekistan, from natural-gas composition analysis, take priority when they exist (TZ-2 l.94).
requirements.evidence: src/refdata/initial.js:43 fuel.natural_gas (38 GJ/1000m3, 56) and :50 fuel.ipcc_natural_gas (34.3, 56.1) both sit in reference data with no tier or priority flag. src/api/registry.js:52-54 accepts any existing fuel.* key on a stream. src/core/process-calc.js:123-124 lets a stream-level ncv/ef override the reference value with no evidence document; sourceLevel is self-declared. Probe (scratchpad\critic\probe.js on a seed copy): 1000 thousand m3 gives 2128.0 t CO2 with natural_gas and 1924.2 t with ipcc_natural_gas (-9.58%).
requirements.gap: No 'national > IPCC' rule exists. An exporter can pick the IPCC gas entry and report about 9.6% lower combustion emissions. A stream-level NCV/EF override needs no lab evidence or approval.
requirements.fix: Add tier: 'national'|'ipcc'|'lab' and a fuelFamily field to the fuel.* values in refdata.js validation. In registry.js checkStream, allow only the highest-priority active entry of each family (ipcc_* only when no national value exists, or for comparison). Require evidenceId (a lab protocol document) plus source_level='lab' for any stream or monthly ncv/ef override, and show overrides to the verifier. Test: picking ipcc_natural_gas while fuel.natural_gas is national is rejected.

requirements.requirement: Check meter uncertainty and data completeness for monthly data (TZ-2 l.137).
requirements.evidence: meters.uncertainty and calibration_date are stored (src/db/schema.js:40-43, src/api/registry.js:261) and activity.uncertainty is validated 0-100 (src/api/data.js:44-45), but nothing reads them. Grep finds no consumer in core, services or ai. qualityIndex (src/api/data.js:73+) covers only completeness and timeliness.
requirements.gap: Completeness is checked, but meter uncertainty is never aggregated, compared with tier thresholds, or checked for expired calibration.
requirements.fix: In services/quality.js, compute per-stream combined uncertainty (meter plus monthly value) and flag calibration_date older than the interval or a missing certificate_doc_id. Compare against the 2023/1773 tier limits kept in refdata (quality.tier_limits.*). Show the results in qualityIndex, the verifier view and the package warnings. Add unit tests.

requirements.requirement: Compare activity data automatically with Tax Committee e-invoices, customs declarations and the Energy ministry balance. Raise a signal when the difference exceeds 2%, automatically every month (TZ-2 l.138, AI-4 l.221).
requirements.evidence: src/ai/anomaly.js:178-191 reconcile() compares only customs and manual/csv batch tonnage per TIF, and only when both sources exist for the same TIF. Probe for op_cement 2025: sources [["customs"]] and 0 signals. Grep finds no e-faktura or energy-balance input. No scheduler exists (grep setInterval/cron in src finds nothing); the check runs only on demand through GET /api/ai/reconcile (src/api/ai.js:102-106), and its output is not stored.
requirements.gap: There is no e-invoice or energy-balance reconciliation, no monthly automatic run, and no persisted signals. Customs is never compared with production.
requirements.fix: Add adapters, mocked until access is granted, for e-faktura fuel volumes (I2) and energy balance or grid-operator MWh (I6). In reconcile(), compare monthly fuel, electricity and output streams with these sources, using the >2% rule. Add a monthly job runner (src/jobs.js, started from server.js) that stores signals in ai_log (kind='reconcile') and notifies operators.

requirements.requirement: P_UZS = P_USD * FX_t, using the exchange rate set in the State Budget law (TZ-2 l.147-148).
requirements.evidence: src/services/tax.js:20 and :51 take ref.get('fx.USD'). src/api/admin.js:197-212 (CBU sync) overwrites that same key with the daily Central Bank rate (systemSet, validFrom = rate date). src/refdata/initial.js:77 labels fx.USD as 'Markaziy bank bilan yangilanadi'. src/api/finance.js:154 defaults a payment's fx to the year-end snapshot instead of the payment date.
requirements.gap: One fx.USD key serves both the budget-law tax rate and the daily CBU rate (also used for EUR conversion). After a CBU sync, carbon-tax rates in UZS move daily instead of using the fixed budget-law rate, and a Q1 payment is converted at the latest rate.
requirements.fix: Split the keys into fx.budget.USD.<year> (budget law, approved by two people) and fx.cbu.USD / fx.cbu.EUR (daily). Use fx.budget in tax.fuelRates, declaration and revenueForecast; use payment-date CBU, or the declared fx, for payments; use CBU or ECB rates for CBAM EUR conversion. Update the acceptance tests.

requirements.requirement: P_UZ is 5 USD/tCO2e for 2026-2030, then rises in steps up to 10 USD/tCO2e over 2031-2035 (TZ-2 l.144-145).
requirements.evidence: src/refdata/initial.js:66-67 sets a flat 10 USD for every year 2031-2035 (source note: 'Ilova A.2 dagi o'zgarmas 10 USD; Q7').
requirements.gap: The text says 'up to 10, stepwise', but Ilova A.2 assumes 10 from 2031. The stepwise path is not modelled, and the conflict is not flagged as an open policy question in the UI.
requirements.fix: Keep flat 10 as the A.2 acceptance baseline, but allow an alternative stepwise schedule key (tax.rate_usd_path=step|flat) for scenarios. Ask IMV to decide the official path.

requirements.requirement: Implement CCI and RCCI = (SEE_firm - SEE_EU) * P / p_g. Sensitivity covers demand ±5-10%, collection ±3-5 p.p., FX, and EU ETS 70/87/100/130 (TZ-2 l.188-189).
requirements.evidence: src/core/pricing.js:137-139 defines rcci(), but grep finds it used only in kb.js text: there is no API or UI, and no SEE_EU value in refdata. src/services/cbam.js:99-100 varies only ee (±5/10%), pEts and sCov. There is no k_comp (collection) or FX sensitivity, including for the revenue forecast.
requirements.gap: RCCI is never computed for any exporter. Collection-rate and FX sensitivity are missing.
requirements.fix: Add refdata keys benchmark.see_eu.<cn8> and return rcci from /api/dashboard/exporter and cbam.scenario. Extend the sensitivity variations with fx (±10%) for burden and with kComp (±0.03/±0.05) in tax.revenueForecast, and expose both in views/cbam.js and tax.js.

requirements.ref: 6.7 ITMO double-counting block and ER verification
requirements.requirement: ITMO_trade = 0.8 * ER_ver and ITMO_buffer = 0.2 * ER_ver, from verified ER. Units of state-participated projects are held by the Government. The platform blocks the same reduction from being counted twice (in ITMO and in CBAM SEE) (TZ-2 l.191-192).
requirements.evidence: src/api/finance.js:196-200 blocks registration only when scope='cbam_goods' and the linked installation-year is already verified. :202 sets verified=1 automatically on registration, with no ER verification step. src/api/verification.js:104-124 (conclude) contains no ITMO check, so a verification after registration is not blocked. state_owned is stored (:187) but has no effect. Probe: a 2027 cbam_goods project registered with verified=1, trade=240; a state-owned project registered to op_cement with trade=320. src/api/finance.js:174 calls core.itmo without itmo.trade_share, so the src/refdata/initial.js:91 parameter is ignored (src/core/pricing.js:161 hard-codes 0.8).
requirements.gap: The double-counting check runs in one direction only and is skipped for scope 'other'. ER is marked verified without verification. The state-ownership rule is not applied. The trade share is hard-coded.
requirements.fix: Add a verifier attestation step (itmo status 'er_verified', with verifier_id and evidence) before register. Check in both directions: at verification conclude and calc submit, block or flag installation-years that have registered ITMO linked to the same installation, whatever the scope. For state_owned=1, route units to a Government registry account. Read itmo.trade_share from the refdata snapshot. Add API tests.

requirements.ref: 8 AI conclusions confirmed by a human and traced
requirements.requirement: AI never replaces the formulas. Every AI conclusion is confirmed by a human and its trace is kept (TZ-2 l.215).
requirements.evidence: Anomaly decisions (src/api/ai.js:49-59) and gap-fill acceptances (:80-82) are written to ai_log. AI-6 forecast (:88-92), AI-7 recommendations (:93-97), AI-9 risk (:98-101) and AI-4 reconcile (:102-106) are returned without logging; probe shows ai_log +0 for each. Assistant answers are logged with status 'new' (:117-119), with no decision endpoint.
requirements.gap: Four AI outputs leave no trace, and there is no human approve/reject flow for recommendations, risk scores, forecasts or assistant answers.
requirements.fix: Log every AI output to ai_log (kind, model, version, inputs hash, output). Add POST /api/ai/log/:id/decision, gated by the relevant role, and approve/reject controls in views/ai.js. Keep risk scores and recommendations unofficial until approved.

requirements.requirement: Tax and CBAM amounts come only from the deterministic section 5-6 formulas; the calculation core is independent of AI (TZ-2 l.215, l.268).
requirements.evidence: src/core/*.js require only each other and trace.js (grep of require() in src/core). AI modules (src/ai/*) call the core but never feed amounts into tax.js or cbam.js. The only AI influence is AI-5 values that a human accepted (see the AI-5 row).

requirements.requirement: Isolation forest or autoencoder over monthly SEE, specific fuel consumption, mass-balance closure, and deviation from the sector average, with recall of known errors ≥90% (TZ-2 l.220).
requirements.evidence: src/ai/anomaly.js:51-117 covers fixed cement ranges, mass balance, robust SPC, iForest (feats ≥8) and deviation from the default value. It has no cross-company or sector-average comparison. tests/ai-docs.test.js:13-20 holds one synthetic iForest unit test, and there is no labeled error set or recall measurement. src/api/ai.js:20 states 'recall ≥ 90%' as a target only.
requirements.gap: There is no peer or sector-average check and no evidence that recall reaches 90%. Range rules exist only for cement.
requirements.fix: Add a peer check: same goods group or CN across operators, median and MAD of monthly SEE and TJ/t, with k-anonymity ≥3. Add range rules for steel, fertilizer, aluminium and hydrogen. Build a labeled test set with injected errors (unit, meter, missing stream) and a test asserting recall ≥0.9; store the metric in the model registry.

requirements.ref: AI-5 estimated values kept out of CBAM documents
requirements.requirement: Gap filling uses a time-series model, marks results 'taxminiy' (estimated), and stays within conservative bounds. An unverified value does not enter a CBAM document (TZ-2 l.222).
requirements.evidence: src/ai/anomaly.js:126-149 uses interpolation plus a conservative bound, not a time-series model. src/api/ai.js:80 saves accepted values with status 'estimated'. src/core/process-calc.js:110 only lists estimatedMonths and still sums those values into AD. src/docs/package.js:53-67 builds goods from a saved or live result and never emits estimatedMonths. Probe: after one month was set to 'estimated', the package JSON contained neither 'estimated' nor 'taxminiy'.
requirements.gap: AI-estimated values flow into SEE and the exporter package and O3CI XML with no flag and no exclusion while they remain unverified.
requirements.fix: In package.build, refuse to issue, or mark the good 'contains estimated data', when any line has estimatedMonths and the result is not verified; add an Estimated attribute to toXml and the HTML. selectSee should not treat such results as actual until verified. Optionally replace interpolation with a seasonal model. Add a test.

requirements.ref: AI-6 CBAM cost and emission forecast
requirements.requirement: Scenario model plus gradient boosting or time series driven by EU ETS price, export volume and SEE trend, with MAPE ≤10% on backtest (TZ-2 l.223).
requirements.evidence: src/ai/anomaly.js:152-175 fits a linear trend on monthly direct emissions of one process. The backtest hides only the last 3 points (:167-171), and the MAPE target is reported, not enforced. Probe: model 'linear-trend', 21 points, backtestMape 0.035. There is no CBAM-cost forecast and no ETS or export-volume drivers; those live only in the deterministic cbam.scenario.
requirements.gap: No cost forecast, no exogenous drivers, a weak backtest protocol, and nothing happens when MAPE exceeds 10%.
requirements.fix: Add a forecast of exports (batches) and SEE with a seasonal or GBM model, combined with ETS price scenarios to give a cost path. Run a rolling-origin backtest over ≥12 months, store MAPE in the model registry, and warn or block display when MAPE > 0.10.

requirements.requirement: RAG answers only from approved platform documents (CBAM acts, PF-110, Strategy, guidelines), with a source link; no answer without a source (TZ-2 l.225).
requirements.evidence: src/ai/kb.js:7-30 holds 22 hard-coded passages paraphrasing TZ-2 plus one PF-110 summary. There is no CBAM act text, no Strategy and no guidelines, and no upload, approval or versioning of KB documents. The no-source refusal is implemented (src/ai/assistant.js:12-14, :32).
requirements.gap: The required corpus is missing and cannot be extended without a code change. Citations are passage ids with no document link or section.
requirements.fix: Add a kb_documents table (file, version, approved_by under the two-person rule, validity) with chunking and indexing at approval, and an admin UI. Make citations carry document id, section and link. Load the official texts.

requirements.requirement: Rank enterprises by risk for tax and verification inspections, every quarter (TZ-2 l.226).
requirements.evidence: src/ai/advice.js:68-94 computes scores on each GET /api/ai/risk (src/api/ai.js:98-101) with factors. There is no scheduled quarterly run, no stored history, and no link to inspection or verification planning. Probe: 3 rows, ai_log +0.
requirements.gap: There are no quarterly snapshots, trend or audit of risk scores, and the scores feed no workflow.
requirements.fix: Run a quarterly job that writes risk snapshots (risk_scores table plus ai_log), add a history view, and let IMV or Tax confirm a ranking that becomes the inspection list.

requirements.requirement: The model registry records version, training data, quality metrics and the responsible person (TZ-2 l.229).
requirements.evidence: src/api/ai.js:17-27 has a static MODELS array: targets only, no training-data description, no measured metrics. :32 returns responsible: 'Uslubiyot administratori' for every model. AI-1 and AI-2 are 'rejalashtirilgan' (planned).
requirements.gap: The registry is hard-coded and holds no measured metrics, training-data lineage or named owner.
requirements.fix: Add an ai_models table (code, version, training-data hash and description, metrics JSON with eval date, owner user id, approved_by) filled by evaluation scripts, and serve it from /api/ai/models.

requirements.ref: 8 AI governance - quarterly re-evaluation and drift
requirements.requirement: Model quality is re-evaluated every quarter and drift is tracked automatically (TZ-2 l.232).
requirements.evidence: No scheduler (grep setInterval|cron in src finds nothing), no evaluation scripts, and no drift metrics in ai.js or anomaly.js.
requirements.gap: There is no periodic evaluation and no drift detection.
requirements.fix: Add a quarterly job: recompute metrics on labeled or confirmed ai_log decisions (precision and recall from confirmed/dismissed anomalies, forecast MAPE), compute PSI on input features, store the results in ai_models, and notify methodology_admin on degradation.

requirements.requirement: Models and data stay on servers in Uzbekistan, and trade secrets are not sent to external services (TZ-2 l.231, NFR l.271).
requirements.evidence: The default AI_EXTERNAL_ALLOWED=0 (src/config.js:43). When enabled, src/ai/assistant.js:24-28 sends the operator's per-process SEE and AL (src/api/ai.js:115) to api.anthropic.com, outside Uzbekistan. public/index.html loads fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com, and the CSP at src/http/app.js:23 whitelists them, so every user's browser contacts foreign servers.
requirements.gap: A configuration switch can send production volumes and SEE abroad, and the UI depends on a foreign CDN.
requirements.fix: Allow only a locally hosted LLM endpoint (AI_LLM_URL inside Uzbekistan) and drop the external option in production builds. Self-host the IBM Plex fonts under public/fonts and remove the googleapis entries from the CSP.

requirements.requirement: Show the key factors behind every anomaly or recommendation (TZ-2 l.230).
requirements.evidence: src/ai/anomaly.js:47-48 and 85-101 attach factors (value, expected, robust z, top-2 iForest drivers). src/ai/advice.js:60-61 returns the formula and basis for each MACC item, and :84-90 returns risk factors with points.

requirements.ref: 11 AI acceptance tests on held-out sets
requirements.requirement: AI tests meet the section 8 quality criteria on a separate test set: AI-1 ≥98%, AI-2 top-1 ≥95%, AI-3 recall ≥90%, AI-6 MAPE ≤10%, AI-8 no unsourced answers (TZ-2 l.297).
requirements.evidence: tests/ai-docs.test.js:13-26 holds one synthetic iForest test and one KB keyword test. There are no labeled datasets or metric assertions, and AI-1 and AI-2 do not exist.
requirements.gap: No AI acceptance harness exists.
requirements.fix: Add tests/ai-acceptance/ with fixtures (labeled anomalies, historical series, Q&A pairs) and asserting tests per criterion, and produce an evaluation report artefact per model version.

requirements.requirement: Inbound: carbon-tax receipts by budget code (TZ-2 l.255).
requirements.evidence: public/js/views/integrations.js:10 marks I4 GFMIS 'rejalashtirilgan' (planned). Grep finds no GFMIS code in src. Collection in src/api/reports.js:136-147 relies on tax_payments entered by exporters.
requirements.gap: No treasury feed exists, so revenue and collection KPIs use self-declared payments.
requirements.fix: Add an adapter (mock first) that imports receipts by budget code (UGL-01/UGL-02) and period, reconcile them with tax_payments (auto-confirm or flag mismatches), and base the bulletin and KPI-5 collection on treasury receipts.

requirements.requirement: Outbound: installation-level emissions aggregated by IPPU and Energy sectors (TZ-2 l.258).
requirements.evidence: public/js/views/integrations.js:13 marks I7 'rejalashtirilgan' (planned). src/api/calc.js:63-87 computes national direct and indirect totals per installation but maps nothing to IPCC sectors and has no export endpoint.
requirements.gap: There is no IPCC-sector mapping and no inventory export.
requirements.fix: Map stream types to IPCC categories (fuel to 1.A.2; material, clinker, mass balance, gas and CEMS to 2.x IPPU). Add GET /api/reports/inventory?year= (JSON/XML/CSV) for the ecology role and log it to integration_log.

requirements.ref: 9 Integration - Central Bank daily USD/EUR rates
requirements.requirement: Daily USD and EUR rates come in from the Central Bank (TZ-2 l.259).
requirements.evidence: src/api/admin.js:197-217 fetches cbu.uz only when POST /api/integrations/cbu/sync is called (button in public/js/views/integrations.js:34). No scheduler exists. The values are written with systemSet, bypassing the two-person approval.
requirements.gap: Rates are not refreshed daily without a person pressing the button.
requirements.fix: Run a daily job (around 09:00 Tashkent) that calls the sync logic, retries, records failures in integration_log, and alerts sysadmin when a rate is more than one working day old.

requirements.ref: 9 Integrations via REST API (OpenAPI 3.0), interagency platform, all exchanges logged
requirements.requirement: Integrations use a REST API described in OpenAPI 3.0 and run through the interagency integration platform; every exchange is logged (TZ-2 l.263).
requirements.evidence: Repo-wide grep finds no OpenAPI or swagger file; REJA.md:578 says 'OpenAPI fayli yo'q'. integration_log (src/db/schema.js:133-136) is written only for STIR, CBU, ETS and ITMO (src/api/admin.js:184-225, src/api/finance.js:203). Customs batch input (src/api/finance.js:63-66, 90-106) and importer share opens (src/api/reports.js:103-108) appear only in audit, not in the exchange log.
requirements.gap: There is no machine-readable API contract, no interagency-platform adapter, and logging of exchanges is incomplete.
requirements.fix: Generate openapi.json from the route table and validate.js schemas and serve it at /api/openapi.json. Write integration_log entries for customs and CSV declaration imports, share or O3CI pulls, and every adapter call. Add an adapter interface for the interagency platform.

requirements.ref: 11 Integration acceptance - at least 100 real records per external system
requirements.requirement: Integration tests exchange at least 100 real records with each external system (TZ-2 l.296).
requirements.evidence: Most adapters are mock or manual (public/js/views/integrations.js:6-20). tests/ contain no integration tests against external systems.
requirements.gap: No integration test programme or protocols exist.
requirements.fix: Write contract tests per adapter against sandbox endpoints, with a replay fixture of ≥100 records per system and a generated protocol report.

requirements.ref: 9 Data model - precursor consumption and installation attributes
requirements.requirement: Precursor consumption records type, quantity, supplier installation, SEE and its type (actual or default). Installation records ID, coordinates, sector and its process list (TZ-2 l.238, l.243).
requirements.evidence: src/db/schema.js:44-51: streams store precursor_source, supplier_see_dir and supplier_see_ind, but no supplier installation ID, name or country, and no actual/default type for supplier-provided SEE. src/db/schema.js:28-32: installations have no sector column.
requirements.gap: A supplier precursor SEE cannot be traced to a supplier installation, and its basis (actual verified or default) is unknown.
requirements.fix: Add supplier_installation_ref, supplier_name, supplier_country, supplier_see_type ('actual_verified'|'actual'|'default') and supplier_evidence_id to streams, required when precursor_source='supplier'. Add installations.sector. Include them in the package and XML.

requirements.ref: 9 Data model - process covers several TIF codes
requirements.requirement: A production process lists TIF codes (plural), and a batch links to its process by TIF code (TZ-2 l.239, scenario l.210).
requirements.evidence: src/db/schema.js:36 processes.tif_code holds a single code. src/services/cbam.js:11-14 linkProcess matches by equality only. src/services/cbam.js:34 applies the process-level SEE and the default for the process's own code to every batch. src/api/finance.js:41 accepts a manual processId without checking that the batch TIF or goods group matches.
requirements.gap: A rolling mill producing several CN codes cannot auto-link most of its batches. Batches of other codes receive the default value of the process's code. A batch can be linked to a process of another goods group.
requirements.fix: Add a process_tif_codes table (process_id, tif_code). linkProcess should match on membership. For default and markup selection, use the batch's own tif code. Reject processId whose goods group differs from tif.<code>.group. Migrate the existing tif_code. Add tests.

requirements.requirement: The monitoring plan is approved at the start of the year, data is collected monthly, then AI check, annual report by 31 March, verification by 30 June, package and O3CI before the importer's 30 September declaration. Deadlines are confirmed in Ecology ministry guidance (TZ-2 l.264).
requirements.evidence: src/services/notify.js:25-36 hard-codes the deadline dates and only lists them. No reminder or overdue notifications are generated (no scheduler). src/db/schema.js:81-86 and src/api/registry.js:311-340: monitoring plans carry no reporting year, and data entry and calc never require an approved plan. Annual report submission (src/api/calc.js:50-60) is not compared with the 31 March deadline.
requirements.gap: Deadlines cannot be changed without a code change when Ecology guidance changes them. Nothing enforces or escalates the cycle, and plan approval is not tied to a year.
requirements.fix: Move deadlines to refdata (mrv.deadline.*). Add monitoring_plans.year and warn or block saving results for a year without an approved plan. Run a daily job that sends reminders at T-30/T-7 and flags overdue reports and verifications in the gov dashboard.

requirements.requirement: Microservice architecture: integration and AI layer, deterministic calculation core, output layer (documents, O3CI, dashboards) (TZ-2 l.266-268).
requirements.evidence: A single Node process registers every module in src/app.js:16 and one HTTP server listens in server.js:14. The layers exist only as folders (src/core, src/ai, src/docs, src/api).
requirements.gap: The code is a modular monolith, not microservices; the calculation core cannot be deployed or scaled separately.
requirements.fix: Either get the customer to accept a modular monolith for the pilot, or split it into services (calc-core, ai, integration, docs, api-gateway) behind REST with the core reused as a library. At minimum, run recalculation and AI in worker processes.

requirements.requirement: TLS 1.2 or higher (TZ-2 l.272).
requirements.evidence: server.js:14 starts plain http.createServer (src/http/app.js:48). SECURE_COOKIES defaults to '0' (src/config.js:42; src/api/auth.js:24-25). There is no HSTS header in SEC_HEADERS (src/http/app.js:19-24). README.md:48 relies on an external proxy.
requirements.gap: Nothing in the repo enforces TLS: no proxy configuration, no HSTS, and the Secure cookie is off by default.
requirements.fix: Add an optional native https server (minVersion 'TLSv1.2', modern ciphers) or ship an nginx reference configuration. Send Strict-Transport-Security when PUBLIC_URL is https. Default SECURE_COOKIES=1 when NODE_ENV=production.

requirements.requirement: The database is encrypted (TZ-2 l.272).
requirements.evidence: src/db/db.js:18 opens a plain node:sqlite DatabaseSync. users.totp_secret is stored in plaintext (src/db/schema.js:14; src/api/auth.js:87), and so are documents.content BLOBs (schema.js:62). data/signing.key sits beside the database. REJA.md:578 records 'bazada AES-256 yo'q'.
requirements.gap: There is no encryption at rest for any data, including 2FA secrets and evidence documents.
requirements.fix: Use encrypted storage (SQLCipher, or PostgreSQL with TDE or disk encryption), or app-level AES-256-GCM for sensitive columns (totp_secret, documents.content) with keys in a KMS or HSM, not in data/.

requirements.requirement: Two-factor authentication (TZ-2 l.272).
requirements.evidence: src/auth/rbac.js:14-16: tax, ecology and customs have scope 'all' (every company's data) with mfa:false. :9 exporter_specialist (data.write) has mfa:false. Probe output: 'tax:scope=all,mfa=false | ecology:scope=all,mfa=false | customs:scope=all,mfa=false'.
requirements.gap: The roles with the widest access to company data, and those that enter data, can log in with a password only.
requirements.fix: Set mfa:true for every role that has company-level scope or a write permission (tax, ecology, customs, exporter_specialist, energy), and add an API test.

requirements.requirement: Every change is logged in an audit trail that cannot be altered (TZ-2 l.272).
requirements.evidence: src/db/audit.js:10 builds an unkeyed SHA-256 chain. src/db/schema.js:118-119 has UPDATE/DELETE triggers. GET /api/audit/verify (src/api/admin.js:110) only recomputes the chain.
requirements.gap: Anyone with write access to the database file can drop the triggers, rewrite rows and recompute the unkeyed chain without detection. The head hash is never anchored outside the database.
requirements.fix: Key the chain with an HMAC whose key lives in an HSM or KMS. Publish a signed daily head-hash digest to a WORM store or to IMV/Ecology, and check against it in verify(). Run verify on startup and daily.

requirements.ref: 10 Security - annual penetration test and security testing
requirements.requirement: Annual penetration test; load and security tests at acceptance (TZ-2 l.272, l.298).
requirements.evidence: No SAST/SCA configuration, CI or pentest reports in the repo. REJA.md:578 records X6 'SAST/SCA yo'q' and X7/X8 unchecked.
requirements.gap: There is no security test programme.
requirements.fix: Add a CI workflow (SAST with semgrep or CodeQL, plus npm audit), an OWASP ASVS L2 checklist, and a yearly third-party pentest whose report is stored under docs/security.

requirements.ref: 10 Performance - 1000 concurrent users, ≤30 s per enterprise, ≤5 min scenario recalc
requirements.requirement: More than 1000 concurrent users; one enterprise's annual calculation in ≤30 s; scenario recalculation for all exporters in ≤5 min (TZ-2 l.274).
requirements.evidence: Probe (scratchpad\critic\perf.js on a seed copy, 103 operators and 137 processes): computeProcess 1-9 ms, GET /api/dashboard/gov 249 ms, unauthenticated GET /api/public/summary 238 ms, riskScores 529 ms. Every request recomputes every process synchronously on the single event loop (src/api/admin.js:146-163, :177-181), with no caching or rate limit on the public endpoint. There are no load tests in the repo.
requirements.gap: Per-enterprise speed is fine, but there is no evidence for 1000 concurrent users. Synchronous full recomputation on every public request blocks the server as data grows, which also makes it a denial-of-service vector.
requirements.fix: Cache aggregates per year and invalidate them on activity, batch or refdata changes. Run heavy recomputation in worker_threads. Rate-limit /api/public/*. Add autocannon or k6 load tests at 1000 virtual users, and a scenario-recalc benchmark with assertions.

requirements.ref: 10 Availability - daily backup, recovery time ≤4 h
requirements.requirement: Back up daily and recover within ≤4 hours (TZ-2 l.275).
requirements.evidence: Repo-wide grep for backup or zaxira finds no code or script; only REJA.md:417 mentions it. The database is a single SQLite file (src/config.js:39).
requirements.gap: There is no backup job, retention, restore procedure or drill.
requirements.fix: Run a daily backup job (sqlite backup API or VACUUM INTO, encrypted, copied to off-host storage inside Uzbekistan), with retention policy and a restore script. Add a restore runbook with a measured RTO under 4 h, and test the restore in CI.

requirements.ref: 10/11 Calculation accuracy - at least 3 Excel reference cases per goods group (≤0.1%)
requirements.requirement: Results match the reference Excel to within 0.1%. Ilova A examples, plus at least 3 hand-calculated (Excel) reference cases per goods group (TZ-2 l.276, l.294).
requirements.evidence: tests/acceptance.test.js:11-113 covers Ilova A.1-A.4, Ilova B and the 6.2 examples at ≤0.1%. tests/core.test.js:75-143 holds synthetic process cases for cement, steel and fertilizer only. There are no aluminium or hydrogen process tests and no Excel reference files.
requirements.gap: Reference cases are missing for aluminium and hydrogen, and no group has 3 Excel-backed cases.
requirements.fix: Add tests/etalon/<group>/*.json fixtures (inputs plus expected values exported from the customer's Excel), 3 or more per group, run through the full computeProcess and cbam path with within(…, 0.001).

requirements.ref: 10 Versioning - results reproducible at any time
requirements.requirement: Every result is tied to the reference versions it used and can be reproduced at any time (TZ-2 l.277).
requirements.evidence: src/services/calc.js:66-74 stores the result JSON, refs (key and version) and inputs_hash. Inputs are not snapshotted (src/db/schema.js:75-80), and there is no endpoint that recomputes a stored result with its pinned reference versions. Activity can still change until verification locks it.
requirements.gap: A stored result can be shown but not independently recomputed from its original inputs and reference data.
requirements.fix: Store a canonical inputs snapshot (streams plus activity, compressed) or activity version ids in calc_results. Add GET /api/results/:id/replay that rebuilds a ref snapshot from the pinned versions, recomputes, and compares the hash and values.

requirements.ref: 10 Language - Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), Russian, English
requirements.requirement: The interface is in Uzbek (Latin and Cyrillic), Russian and English; report templates are also in English (TZ-2 l.278).
requirements.evidence: public/js/i18n.js:5-16 translates only about 40 menu labels for ru and en, and the rest of the UI stays in Uzbek (README.md:96). Cyrillic is an automatic transliteration (i18n.js:24-40). API error messages are Uzbek only. The package has uz/ru/en labels (src/docs/package.js:18-41); the coexistence xlsx is Uzbek only (src/api/reports.js:157).
requirements.gap: The Russian and English UI is incomplete, and backend messages and some reports are single-language.
requirements.fix: Externalise all UI strings and backend messages into i18n catalogs (uz-Latn, uz-Cyrl, ru, en), and localise the bulletin, coexistence and annual xlsx templates.

requirements.ref: 10 Usability - responsive web and mobile, WCAG 2.1 AA
requirements.requirement: Responsive web and mobile interface meeting WCAG 2.1 AA (TZ-2 l.279).
requirements.evidence: public/css/style.css has @media breakpoints at 1100, 900 and 760 px, prefers-reduced-motion and focus-visible rules; public/index.html includes a skip link and a viewport meta tag. REJA.md:578 records 'WCAG audit o'tkazilmagan' (no WCAG audit done).
requirements.gap: WCAG 2.1 AA conformance has not been verified.
requirements.fix: Run an axe-core audit in CI over all views, fix contrast, labels and table/chart semantics, and document a conformance statement.

requirements.ref: 10 Technology - open standards, containers (Kubernetes), no vendor lock-in
requirements.requirement: Open standards and API (OpenAPI 3.0), containerisation (Kubernetes), no vendor lock-in (TZ-2 l.280).
requirements.evidence: There is no Dockerfile, Helm chart or Kubernetes manifest in the repo; the file listing shows none. There is no OpenAPI (see the integrations row). The stack has no external dependencies (package.json), which helps avoid lock-in.
requirements.gap: Nothing is ready for container or Kubernetes deployment.
requirements.fix: Add a Dockerfile (node:24-alpine, non-root, DATA_DIR volume), a Helm chart with liveness and readiness probes on /api/system/health, and a PostgreSQL option for multi-replica deployment.

requirements.ref: 11 Stage 2 pilot - 4 pilot enterprises, 2025 data matches reference
requirements.requirement: MVP pilot with O'zkimyoimpeks, Farg'onaazot, Indorama Kokand and Toshkent metallurgiya zavodi. The 2025 calculation matches the reference (SEE 1.99, 2.40, 0.80, 3.21) and the pilots' packages are ready; pilots and verifier give positive opinions (TZ-2 l.287, l.299).
requirements.evidence: scripts/seed-demo.js:41-43 seeds three fictional operators ('A Sement', 'B Metall', 'C Kimyo'). No pilot installation data or onboarding import exists. tests/acceptance.test.js:11-29 checks A.1 only as EE = m × SEE arithmetic, not as a platform calculation from monitoring data.
requirements.gap: No pilot data has been loaded or reconciled against the A.1 reference values.
requirements.fix: Build an onboarding importer (EU Communication template or xlsx) for the pilot installations, load the 2025 monitoring data, and add an acceptance test that the platform reproduces the A.1 SEE and EE for each pilot within 0.1%.

requirements.requirement: Source code and licences (ownership to the customer), architecture and API documents, user and admin manuals, test programme and protocols, AI models and their reports, training materials in 3 languages, training for at least 100 users, 12-month warranty (TZ-2 l.292).
requirements.evidence: Only README.md and REJA.md exist. REJA.md:584 itself lists technical design, OpenAPI, manuals, security policy and training materials as not done. There is no LICENSE or ownership statement, and tests/ has no test protocols.
requirements.gap: Most documentation deliverables are absent.
requirements.fix: Produce docs/architecture.md, OpenAPI, docs/user-guide.{uz,ru,en}.md, docs/admin-guide.md, a test programme with generated protocol reports from node --test, AI model cards from ai_models, and a LICENSE assigning rights to the customer.

requirements.ref: 11 Default-value acceptance test for all TIF codes (2026/2027/2028 mark-up)
requirements.requirement: For every TIF code in the loaded table, the 2026, 2027 and 2028 mark-ups are applied correctly (TZ-2 l.295).
requirements.evidence: src/refdata/initial.js:96-113 holds only 14 sample codes, several of them dvStatus 'missing'. tests/acceptance.test.js:63-78 checks two codes (2523290000 cement and fertilizer 2.67). CBAM_TIF_codes_for_UZB_updated.xlsx is not in the repo.
requirements.gap: There is no table-driven test over about 285 codes because the source table is absent.
requirements.fix: When the xlsx arrives, add a generated test that imports it through tifRowsToEntries and, for each code with dvStatus 'value', asserts defaultSee = DV × (1 + mu_group,year) for 2026-2028, and for '-' codes asserts that basis stays 'actual' only.

requirements.ref: Ilova A / Ilova B reference examples
requirements.requirement: The Ilova A.1-A.4 worked examples and the Ilova B initial coefficients (EF, heat value, combustion emission per unit) are loaded and form part of the test set (TZ-2 l.302-339, l.276).
requirements.evidence: tests/acceptance.test.js:11-108 checks A.1 (EE and 100% CBAM at 87 USD), A.2 (the 2026-2034 table and policy signal), A.3 (1.692), A.4 (3.26 t/t and 197 000 UZS/t), the 6.2 diesel and AI-80 examples, and Ilova B kg/m3 and kg/t for 6 fuels at ≤0.1%. src/refdata/initial.js:43-48 holds the Ilova B values. node --test acceptance plus core: 24/24 pass.
